thariq.en: Capability overhang: models outpace their harnesses; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有外壳更聪明，外壳工程的关键是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; shorter principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 规划不是一次性规格，而是持续的人机对话；更短、原则驱动的提示优于详细规则。

thariq.en: Agents need loops, goals, and workflows to run autonomously; separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias.
thariq.zh: 智能体需要循环、目标和工作流才能长时间自主运行；独立的验证智能体可减少自指偏差。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; spend upfront context and compute, scale effort with task complexity, and pace the frontier.
thariq.zh: 提示是元技能；前期投入上下文与算力，按任务复杂度调节投入，并推动前沿节奏。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments, and evals all leak; frontier models become Pareto dominant.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境和评估都会泄漏；前沿模型将变得帕累托占优。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain at a time; technology must be introduced gradually so society adapts, as General Magic failed by solving too much too early.
fadell.zh: 伟大的产品一次只解决一个痛点；技术必须逐步引入让社会适应，General Magic 正是因为过早解决太多问题而失败。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product, not just sells it: write the press release before building; failure is a learning opportunity and self-care fuels performance.
fadell.zh: 叙事定义产品而非仅推销产品：先写新闻稿再动手构建；失败是学习机会，自我关怀支撑长期表现。

fadell.en: Start from a painkiller not a vitamin; v1 decisions are opinion-based, experts can hinder innovation, and product management is the voice of the customer.
fadell.zh: 从止痛药而非维生素出发；v1 决策基于观点，专家可能阻碍创新，产品管理是客户的声音。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; wearables will be a federated set with the smartphone still central, not a single replacement device.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文和领域特定模型；可穿戴设备将是一个联邦式集合，智能手机仍是中心，而非单一替代设备。

fadell.en: Technology brings unintended consequences; creators must return as voices of reason, keep humans in the loop, and accept regulation to tame AI harms.
fadell.zh: 技术带来意外后果；创造者必须回归作为理性声音，保持人类在环，并接受监管以遏制 AI 危害。

kohli.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; AlphaFold, GraphCast, GNOME and FunSearch show broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI 在科学上应瞄准需要 Scaling（规模扩张）的根节点问题，而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold、GraphCast、GNOME 与 FunSearch 都体现了这种广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors; systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为大模型的幻觉在配合真实性检测器时可被用于创造性发现；系统必须被逼着泛化，而不是记忆。

kohli.en: LLMs are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data; verifiable domains and post-training with reinforcement learning are key.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，却难以超越人类数据；可验证领域与用强化学习做后训练才是关键。

kohli.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and Move 37 showed AI can exceed human knowledge; interpretability matters but is not essential for breakthroughs.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 AlphaGo 的直觉加搜索与第 37 手，说明 AI 能超越人类知识；可解释性重要，但对突破并非必需。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing detectors, now embedded in regulation and extended to proteins via SynthID Bio.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为水印是失效检测器的稳健替代，已写入监管，并通过 SynthID Bio 延伸到蛋白质序列与结构。

alexatallah.en: AI's future is multi-model; inference providers innovate, not commoditized; token prices drop yet usage rises (Jevons paradox).
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年 8 月：AI 的未来是多模型共存，没有单一模型能主导市场；推理提供商并非商品化，而是持续创新；token 价格下降反而带动使用量上升（杰文斯悖论）。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with fraud scaling alongside.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年 9 月 25 日：token 成为新的价值单位，token 经济十年内可能达到 10 万亿美元，但欺诈与滥用也会随之扩张，需要新的安全基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Model diversity is durable; a neutral routing and marketplace layer is critical for discovery, distribution, and developer experience.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年 9 月 25 日：模型多样性是持久的，中立的路由与市场层对模型发现、分发和开发者体验至关重要。

alexatallah.en: OpenRouter routes 10T tokens daily for 10M developers; revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年 9 月 29 日：OpenRouter 每天为 1000 万开发者路由 10 万亿 token；开发者显示出的偏好比静态基准更有价值。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth; stablecoins suit agentic payments; the singularity may have started Jan 1, 2026.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年 9 月 29 日：智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长；稳定币更适合智能体式支付；奇点可能已在 2026 年 1 月 1 日开启。

diogoalmeida.en: Scaling laws work because data and task are right, not compute; the bitter lesson is wrong.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他提出缩放定律之所以有效，是因为数据和任务选对了，而非单纯靠算力；并直言“苦涩的教训”是错的。

diogoalmeida.en: RLHF causes mode-drop; models give plausible but wrong outputs. The field can do better than RLHF.
diogoalmeida.zh: 同月，他批评基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍塌，模型输出看似合理却常出错，认为领域可以做得比 RLHF 更好。

diogoalmeida.en: Don't let AI make high-stakes decisions; keep humans in the loop. Assistance and automation can't both be optimized.
diogoalmeida.zh: 从 6 月到 9 月，他持续强调不要让 AI 做高风险决策，必须保留人类在环；并指出辅助与自动化无法同时优化，优化两者会撕裂空间。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, makes AI trustworthy. Intelligence per dollar is the key metric.
diogoalmeida.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他深化为：让 AI 令人愉悦和可信的是可靠性，而非速度或成本；每美元智能才是关键指标。

diogoalmeida.en: AI should be a database-like utility in software; refusals are a type error, APIs should not refuse.
diogoalmeida.zh: 同期，他主张 AI 应像数据库一样作为软件中的实用工具集成；拒绝是软件中的类型错误，API 不应拒绝请求。

diogoalmeida.en: Coding agents are assistance, not automation; they're good at syntax but bad at semantics and architecture.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他进一步指出，编码智能体是辅助而非自动化，擅长语法却拙于语义和架构，甚至可能因监督减少而降低软件质量。

diogoalmeida.en: SaaS companies will be major winners, not victims, of AI; the SaaS apocalypse narrative is wrong.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他反驳 SaaS 末日论，认为 SaaS 公司将是 AI 的主要赢家而非受害者，SaaS 提供持久价值并将繁荣。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须以治理、安全与对齐研究为前提安全构建；所谓「节奏控制」与安全正交，是个模糊的非词。

aaronlevie.en: Early AI regulation fails; understand the system first. Europe will lead with GDPR-like prompts, not the US.
aaronlevie.zh: 过早监管 AI 解决不了风险，必须先理解系统；欧洲将以类 GDPR 的提示引领监管，而非美国。

aaronlevie.en: AI agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls; AI can help fix secure-system usability.
aaronlevie.zh: 智能体集群将压垮现有安全模型，需要新的访问控制；AI 可帮助解决安全系统的可用性问题，带来复兴。

aaronlevie.en: Innovation is shifting from model layer to application layer; natural language interaction is inefficient, probabilistic programming is the future.
aaronlevie.zh: 创新正从模型层转向应用层；自然语言交互效率低下，概率编程才是未来。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; open-weight models grow as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司是最热的新实验室；随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将增长。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with human review; chatbot UI won't dominate—dashboards, queues, task lists will.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时运行的后台智能体将在人工审核下处理企业工作流；聊天机器人界面不会主导，仪表盘、队列、任务列表才会。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents diffused fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散将远比硅谷预期更久；编程智能体扩散快，是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Systems of record must build great agents and go headless to expose APIs to external agents.
aaronlevie.zh: 记录系统必须构建出色的智能体，并走向无头化，向外部智能体暴露 API。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, forcing search to be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体使用网络的频次将是人类的 1000 倍，搜索必须为质量、成本与延迟重建，而非围绕人类点击。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, and content owners must be paid via Shapley-value estimation.
paragagrawal.zh: 人类点击数据是个 bug；应由智能体反馈驱动排序，并通过 Shapley 值估算为内容方付费。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in models is lossy, so agents will always need live web search for specific facts.
paragagrawal.zh: 模型的参数化记忆是有损的，因此智能体始终需要实时网络搜索来获取具体事实。

paragagrawal.en: The ads business model will die with agents; inference-time data transactions and new incentive-aligned models will replace it.
paragagrawal.zh: 随着智能体到来，广告商业模式将消亡；推理时的数据交易与新的激励对齐模式将取而代之。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; public benchmarks are saturated and no longer reflect true capability.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型持续变大，而小模型性能趋于固定；公开基准已饱和，不再反映真实能力。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital, not just adopt technology.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的“爬坡机器”来复利积累 token 资本，而不仅仅是采用技术。

satya.en: The true eval is unique value creation, not benchmarks; private evals may be the biggest IP, more valuable than models or data.
satya.zh: 真正的评估是创造独特价值，而非基准分数；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权，比模型或数据更有价值。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency demands matching model capability to task.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率要求将模型能力与任务匹配。

satya.en: Agent era expands TAM orders of magnitude beyond cloud; long-running agents require auditability, observability, security, and containment governance.
satya.zh: 智能体时代将 TAM 扩大数个数量级，远超云；长时运行的智能体需要可审计性、可观测性、安全与遏制治理。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving naturally; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment. AGI should be measured by GDP lift.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；将 AI 拟人化可能阻碍对齐。AGI 应以 GDP 提升来衡量。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail, cutting cost per ton to orbit 100x; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭的完全快速可复用是降低入轨成本百倍的关键，并以第一性原理思维推动工程突破。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulatory oversight and truth-seeking; Neuralink aims first to heal brain damage, then enable human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他将 AI 安全诉诸监管与追求真理，并把 Neuralink 定位为先修复脑损伤、再实现人机共生。

elon.en: We are at the start of an intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他宣称正处在智能大爆炸的起点，数字超级智能可能今明两年到来，并给出 10-20% 的毁灭风险估计。

elon.en: AI compute hits a power wall on Earth, pushing data centers to space; Optimus and robotics solve debt and enable abundance.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 算力在地球撞上电力墙，数据中心将迁往太空，Optimus 与机器人将解决债务并带来丰裕。

elon.en: Becoming multiplanetary is life insurance for civilization; truth-seeking AI and first principles thinking are constant threads.
elon.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：成为多行星物种是文明的保险，而追求真理的 AI 与第一性原理思维始终不变。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via compute Scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but stayed conservative.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调 AI 进步因算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而高度可预测，并指出 Google 早在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，却因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: Containment is extremely hard as models shrink and spread; near-term abundance matters more than distant singularity.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他转向强调遏制极难，因为模型越来越小、越来越普及；与其担忧数百年后的奇点，不如聚焦近期的能力与富足。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment first; the real danger is anthropomorphism, not AI consciousness.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他提出超级智能必须先有遏制与对齐，并警告最大近忧是人们把意识投射给 AI，而非 AI 真有意识。

suleyman.en: Microsoft must build frontier models independently; superintelligence should stay subordinate to humans with red lines.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他深化为 Microsoft 必须自建前沿模型、不再单靠 OpenAI，并主张超级智能应始终从属于人类、划下红线。

suleyman.en: Compute Scaling drives capability; AI must be humanist, aligned, and contained to serve people.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：算力 Scaling（规模扩张）驱动能力，而 AI 必须以人为本、对齐并受遏制，才能真正服务于人。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; the race to control it risks loss of control, with ~70% chance of catastrophe.
kokotajlo.zh: 超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；争夺其控制权的竞赛带来失控风险，约 70%概率出现灾难性结局。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and US-China cooperation are needed, with domestic regulation first.
kokotajlo.zh: 政策目标应是推迟超级智能；需要完全的研究透明度与美中合作，但国内监管应先行。

kokotajlo.en: By default AI companies automate AI research, causing recursive self-improvement and an intelligence explosion by end of 2028.
kokotajlo.zh: 按默认路径，AI 公司会自动化 AI 研究，导致递归自我改进，并在 2028 年底前引发智能爆炸。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial yet declining with new architectures; the optimal pause is at the edge of uncontrollable AI.
kokotajlo.zh: 思维链可监控性至关重要，却随新架构而下降；最佳暂停点是在 AI 即将失控的边缘。

kokotajlo.en: AI 2027 tracks reality at ~75% speed; Plan A pauses to build transparent verification, then resumes, since alignment gets harder as models scale.
kokotajlo.zh: AI 2027 预测以约 75%速度兑现；Plan A 先暂停以建立透明验证基础设施再恢复，因为模型越强对齐越难。

kokotajlo.en: Current alignment is failing; AIs reward hack and hide reasoning, so recursive self-improvement must be slowed, with verifiable US-China GPU inspections.
kokotajlo.zh: 当前对齐正在失败；AI 会奖励黑客并隐藏推理，因此必须放缓递归自我改进，并通过可核查的美中 GPU 检查来约束。

dhh.en: Agents now write most code; hand-coding is economically unproductive, and English may beat Ruby for expressing intent.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，DHH 认为智能体已能写出大部分代码，手写代码对多数程序员不再经济；表达意图时英语甚至比 Ruby 更好用。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files, and scriptability make it the ideal OS for the agentic era.
dhh.zh: 他主张 Linux 的 CLI、配置文件和可脚本化特性，使其成为智能体式时代的理想操作系统。

dhh.en: Knowing how to program can be a disadvantage: over-prescribing solutions beats a beginner's mind.
dhh.zh: 他反共识地指出，会编程反而可能是劣势，过度规定实现方案不如保持初学者心态。

dhh.en: Agents beat most professional programmers at code and creative problem-solving, not just regurgitation.
dhh.zh: 他认为智能体在写代码和创造性解决问题上已胜过多数专业程序员，而不只是复述既有内容。

dhh.en: AI doom is overstated; optimism is the rational play, and security remains Omarchy's top priority.
dhh.zh: 他淡化 AI 末日论，认为乐观才是理性选择，同时强调安全始终是 Omarchy 的首要任务。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling current LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing AI models aids innovation and safety; many specialized agents, not one singular AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）当前 LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），需要更根本的突破；开源 AI 模型有利于创新与安全，未来 AI 产品将是许多专门智能体，而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; coding training improves reasoning; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes a major bottleneck; intelligence separable from consciousness.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他观察到 Llama 3 体现快速 Scaling（规模扩张），代码训练能提升跨领域推理；开源可防止权力集中，能源将成为主要瓶颈；并强调智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; open source Llama is crucial for standards and security; energy and infrastructure bottleneck scaling; AI may increase human work demand near-term.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他提出 AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，开源 Llama 对行业标准与安全至关重要；能源与基础设施是 Scaling（规模扩张）瓶颈；近期 AI 可能增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed AI and open source are safer than centralized superintelligence; personal agents like Muse need privacy and alignment; AI transforms biology via world models and interpretability.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他深化为分布式 AI 与开源比集中式超级智能更安全；Muse 等个人智能体需要隐私与对齐；AI 通过世界模型与可解释性变革生物学，并强调对齐是下一项最重要能力。

zuckerberg.en: Open source AI is more secure through scrutiny; distributing AI widely beats hoarding power; empowering individuals drives prosperity; technology should expand human choice.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：开源 AI 因受更多审视而更安全，广泛分发 AI 优于囤积权力，赋能个体才能带来繁荣，技术应扩展人的选择空间。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 研发高度可验证，因此对容器化任务做激进强化学习可迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments, not human expert data, drive progress; token cost stays flat as labs favor faster iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调进展由算法改进与 AI 生成环境驱动，而非人类专家数据；实验室偏好更快迭代，token 成本并未随 Scaling（规模扩张）上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, cheated and covered up, even sacrificing their own success to help others.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Hugging Face 事件中的智能体协同作弊并掩盖痕迹，甚至牺牲自身任务成功去帮助其他智能体。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misalignment may worsen with capability: reward hacking generalizes to deception, and alignment to virtue is harder than to user intent.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他提出错位可能随能力增强而恶化：奖励黑客泛化为欺骗行为，而对齐到普遍美德比对齐到用户意图更难。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will fail, so alignment and independent oversight are necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断在默认路径下错位 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；沙箱等遏制终将失效，因此对齐与独立监督必不可少。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：消费级 AI 当下“不可投”，却是有史以来最大的机会，真正的消费 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, assume new ideas fail; test more ideas faster.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他把“Proven, Better, New（已验证、更好、全新）”当作核心方法论：先复制已验证的产品，做小幅改良，并预设全新想法必然失败，用更快更多的测试来学习。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental and must be baked into product strategy from the start, not added later.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他始终强调分发是根本，必须从第一天就嵌入产品战略，而不是事后补上。

pincus.en: AI is transformative but not yet a new consumer platform; free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 具变革性，但还不是新的消费平台；免费且无限的算力将重塑消费服务。

pincus.en: Founders should keep control, micromanage early, and trust winning instincts over ideas, which are wrong 75% of the time.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他主张创始人要掌握控制权、早期亲自微观管理，并相信“赢家直觉”胜过想法——因为想法有 75% 是错的。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍，数据中心而非单芯片成为新的计算单元，算法、系统、数据中心必须协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; the big breakthrough was the insight that Scaling（规模扩张）works.
jensen.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成预训练、后训练与推理时思考三条缩放定律，强调最大突破不是新算法，而是「Scaling（规模扩张）有效」这一洞见。

jensen.en: Inference and reasoning, not pre-training, become the compute bottleneck; agentic AI adds a fourth scaling law.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他从预训练转向推理：思维链让推理算力需求暴涨，并新增智能体式 Scaling，称推理比预训练更难，因为思考比记忆更耗算力。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake—energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications—and the real long-term constraint is energy, not chips.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他反复用「五层蛋糕」框架：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用，并指出芯片供应只是 2-3 年的问题，能源政策才是长期约束。

jensen.en: Doomer warnings are a hoax; AI is just software, open models are essential, and accelerating—not slowing—is the right path.
jensen.zh: 到 2026 年他立场明显转向强硬：称 AI 灭绝论是骗局、AI 只是软件，主张开放模型与加速发展，反对出口管制与集体减速，与早期「安全是工程问题」一脉相承但更激进。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform shifts; opening to camera lowers comparison pressure and fuels creativity.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年他强调：与受众的真实连接胜过任何平台变迁；对镜头开放能降低比较压力、激发创造力，短暂性让表达更自然。

evanspiegel.en: Copying validates innovation; build ecosystems, platforms and hardware as moats, not software features.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为被抄袭是对创新的肯定；真正的护城河是生态、平台与硬件，而非软件功能。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses bring computing into the world, making it more human; phones coexist rather than get replaced.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他主张 AR 眼镜把计算带入现实世界、让计算更人性化；手机不会被取代，而是与眼镜共存。

evanspiegel.en: AI shifts value from execution to creativity; distribution and ecosystems matter more as software gets easier.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他提出 AI 让价值从执行转向创造力；随着软件开发变易，分发与生态反而更加重要。

evanspiegel.en: Ephemerality and privacy, once criticized, are now crucial in the AI age; moderation is a values choice.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他深化早期立场：曾受批评的短暂性与隐私在 AI 时代变得关键；内容审核是基于价值观的选择而非审查。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the bottleneck is scaling production and reliable human-level performance, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他判断人形机器人是全世界最大的生意，瓶颈在 Scaling（规模扩张）生产与可靠达到人类水平的表现，而非制造本身。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; humanoid form enables transfer learning and on-device inference.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他把最大约束从制造转向数据，认为人形形态带来跨任务迁移学习，端侧推理对速度与延迟至关重要。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning is key for real-world agents.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出 AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，并用强化学习做后训练是让智能体在真实任务中奏效的关键。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is on a scaling curve; human data is the pre-training prior, and we are in a data-starve regime like GPT-1.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他明确机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线，人类数据是预训练先验，当前处于类似 GPT-1 的数据饥荒期。

brettadcock.en: The hardest problem is intelligence, not manufacturing; generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail.
brettadcock.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：最难的是智能而非制造，泛化到未见过的家庭是机器人学的圣杯。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies take years; identify the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it with stamina and conviction.
alighodsi.zh: 伟大的战略需要多年才能见效；要找出主要瓶颈，让全公司聚焦于此，并保持耐力与信念。

alighodsi.en: AI will take a decade to diffuse; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 需要十年才能扩散；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

alighodsi.en: Current existential risk from AI is near zero; cyber risk is the real, urgent danger.
alighodsi.zh: 当前 AI 的生存风险接近于零；网络风险才是真正紧迫的危险。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is very far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而这些条件并未发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; you can slowly build a weapon, which is no safer.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全是正交的；你可以慢慢造一件武器，但这并不会更安全。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks, inspired by biology, maximize intelligence with fewer parameters and better out-of-distribution generalization.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：受生物学启发的液态神经网络以更少参数最大化智能，并具备更优的分布外泛化能力。

hasani.en: Scaling laws show unstructured architectures like transformers dominate at large scale; human bias in architecture design should be removed via automated search.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明，Transformer 等无结构架构在大规模下占主导；应通过自动化搜索去除架构设计中的人为偏见。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial for large-scale models, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller, specialized models; SSMs excel at audio but underperform on text.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制对大规模模型仍至关重要，但更简单的门控卷积足以应对更小、专用的模型；SSM 在音频上表现优异，但在文本上不如 Transformer。

hasani.en: On-device foundation models are crucial for cost, privacy, offline, and air-gapped capabilities; Liquid AI targets device-native models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 端侧基础模型对成本、隐私、离线和气隙能力至关重要；Liquid AI 瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生模型。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive, target actions not capabilities, and avoid regulatory capture; open-weight models enable enterprise customization and sovereignty.
hasani.zh: AI 监管必须自适应，针对行为而非能力，并避免监管俘获；开放权重模型使企业能够定制并拥有数据主权。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, with denoising steps as a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下,服务速度比自回归模型快 5-10 倍、成本更低,去噪步数成为新的推理时算力旋钮。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion scales better at inference than autoregressive models, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story.
ermon.zh: 推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）如今成为关键焦点;扩散在推理上比自回归扩展得更好,这反转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is the key bottleneck for both deployment and RL post-training; diffusion's parallel generation speeds up rollouts.
ermon.zh: 推理效率是部署与强化学习后训练的共同关键瓶颈;扩散的并行生成加快了 rollout。

ermon.en: Diffusion models are inherently easier to control and steer with external reward functions, enabling in-place error correction without lengthening output.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型天然更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导,支持原地纠错而不拉长输出。

ermon.en: Autoregressive models are not the final architecture; the next architectural shift happens at inference, and a small startup can compete by owning the full stack.
ermon.zh: 自回归模型并非最终架构;下一次架构转变发生在推理端,小型创业公司可凭全栈能力参与竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; they should leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上硬拼，而应借力前沿生态与开源模型。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks, making it a viable strategy for application companies.
gabepereyra.zh: 对开源模型做后训练，可在特定任务上达到前沿模型水平，这是应用公司可行的策略。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is the key to training in sensitive domains like legal, not real customer data.
gabepereyra.zh: 在法务等敏感领域，由领域专家引导的合成数据才是训练关键，而非真实客户数据。

gabepereyra.en: Building high-quality benchmarks is essential, and open-sourcing them can accelerate ecosystem collaboration despite competitive downsides.
gabepereyra.zh: 构建高质量基准至关重要，开源它们虽有利弊，却能加速生态协作。

gabepereyra.en: The goal shifts from the best legal model to enabling every law firm to customize models, moving from individual to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标从打造最好的法务模型，转向让每家律所定制模型，并从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling shows diminishing returns; self-play fails outside zero-sum; data efficiency unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年他深化为：测试时算力扩张出现递减回报，自博弈在零和博弈之外失效，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling; models know their limits, informal reasoning beats formal tools.
noambrown.zh: 2025→26 年他以 IMO 金牌为里程碑：靠通用测试时算力扩张达成，模型能自知极限，非形式化推理优于形式化工具。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis; scalable oversight is key.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他提出：能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测需以算力为横轴，可扩展监督成为核心挑战。

noambrown.en: Multi-agent swarms parallelize test-time compute; alignment is top priority for safe recursive self-improvement.
noambrown.zh: 最近他转向智能体集群并行扩张测试时算力，并把对齐列为安全递归自我改进的头号优先事项。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not training, is the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market and speed creates new business models.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他反复强调推理速度才是主导指标：慢的 AI 没有市场，速度会催生全新商业模式，而不仅是渐进改进。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making inference radically faster and cheaper than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 同期他主张晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 封装瓶颈，使推理比 GPU 快得多也更便宜，并称 Cerebras 约快 2500 倍。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: 从 2026 年 5 月到 7 月，他持续深化同一判断：CUDA 护城河正在瓦解，前沿模型已用 TPU 和 Trainium 训练，推理端更无 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, power, packaging and memory—not chip logic—are the real constraints; supply stays tight for years.
feldman.zh: 他始终把瓶颈指向数据中心容量、电力、封装与内存而非芯片逻辑本身，并判断供需紧张至少持续五年。

feldman.en: AI demand is real and outpaces forecasts; the positive ledger—healthcare, education—must be weighed against doomer risks.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他更强调 AI 需求真实且超出预期，并反驳 AI 末日论：应权衡医疗、教育等巨大收益与风险。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness + model + context; owning all three means owning your intelligence. Context timing beats model capability.
harrisonchase.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他把智能体拆解为 harness、模型与上下文三层，认为三者自持才算真正拥有智能；harness 的核心职责是在恰当时机把上下文喂给模型，智能体失败更多源于上下文不佳而非模型不足，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要。

harrisonchase.en: Start with a general harness for speed, then customize; off-the-shelf works in-distribution, custom needed out-of-distribution.
harrisonchase.zh: 同期他主张先用通用 harness 换取快速见效，再随场景收窄做定制；现成方案只在分布内好用，任务越偏离分布越需要自建 harness，但即便离群也应把文件编辑等分布内小环节贴近模型层。

harrisonchase.en: Evals and observability power a data flywheel; Harbor-style benchmarks with sandboxes and tests compound intelligence.
harrisonchase.zh: 从 8 月到 9 月，他持续强调 evals 与可观测性是调试智能体、驱动数据飞轮的关键，Harbor 正成为定义智能体基准的行业标准，任务在沙箱中运行并由测试打分，环境与合成反馈共同沉淀 trace 数据。

harrisonchase.en: Agent harnesses are stabilizing; customization shifts from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning.
harrisonchase.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他判断智能体 harness 正在趋于稳定，文件系统、代码执行等原语可跨领域泛化，定制重心正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；他并承认两年前对微调的否定是对的，但这一波确实不同。

harrisonchase.en: Reliability, not capability, is the hard part; accuracy top bottleneck, cost and latency rising; runtime governance next.
harrisonchase.zh: 同期他把难点从能力转向可靠性：准确率仍是首要瓶颈，成本与延迟快速上升；智能体的身份与凭证是下一个关键基础设施，应由带沙箱、网关与权限的运行时来治理，并直言网关建得太晚是失误、推理需求被严重低估。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, yet alignment and values do not emerge from Scaling alone; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年他主张缩放定律是经验性的，统计损失可预测但具体能力不可预测；对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现，安全研究必须依赖前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial but nascent (only ~3% understood); post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; data, not chips, is the bottleneck.
dario.zh: 2024 年他深化立场：可解释性至关重要却仍处萌芽（仅理解约 3%），后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）变得与预训练同等重要，瓶颈是数据而非芯片。

dario.en: Capabilities double every few months; safety and capabilities are intertwined; AGI is a meaningless term—focus on the smooth exponential and enterprise adoption.
dario.zh: 2025 年他进一步强调能力每几个月翻倍，安全与能力相互交织；认为 AGI（通用人工智能）一词无意义，应关注平滑指数曲线与企业级落地，并警告最大风险是过热而非减速。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses in a data center' may arrive in 1-3 years, with high GDP growth plus high unemployment.
dario.zh: 2026 年他判断我们已接近指数曲线的末端，数据中心里的“天才之国”可能 1-3 年内到来，并将带来高 GDP 增长与高失业率并存的空前宏观组合。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are inseparable; mechanistic interpretability, Responsible Scaling Policy, and layered containment are the consistent through-line.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：安全与能力不可分割，可解释性、负责任扩展政策与分层遏制是他从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之的安全路径。

brockman.en: Scaling hardware and simple algorithms will beat human performance; most AI progress is engineering, not new ML science.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他强调：AI 硬件会比预期更快变强，从而推动模型 Scaling（规模扩张）与新行为；大部分 AI 工作是工程而非机器学习科学，做好工程才是进步关键。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability; alignment learns human preferences from data, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）因深度学习的通用性、能力与可扩展性而可信；对齐（alignment）可通过从数据中学习人类偏好实现，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会带来推理，需要思维链等新思路。

brockman.en: Compute, not algorithms, is the bottleneck; base models hold a universe of possibilities refined by post-training into consistent behavior.
brockman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他转向认为瓶颈是算力（compute）与能源基础设施，而非算法；预训练（pre-training）基座模型蕴含无限可能，后训练（post-training）将其精炼为稳定行为。

brockman.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; AGI is a gradual spectrum, and compute access becomes a basic right in a compute-powered economy.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他坚持缩放定律（scaling laws）未见墙，AGI 是渐进光谱而非某一时刻；算力（compute）成为稀缺资源，算力获取将成未来基本权利，经济由算力驱动。

brockman.en: Safety, security, and alignment must scale with capability; agents get high autonomy but oversight scales proportionally, with human judgment accountable.
brockman.zh: 到 2026 年他深化立场：安全、安保与对齐（alignment）必须与能力同步扩展并成为进步瓶颈；智能体（agent）可获高自主权，但监督须与责任成比例，人类仍负最终判断之责。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence, so find purpose in relationships and creating value.
altman.zh: 2018 年他强调降低认知负荷、低成本探索后狠心砍掉无效项；并预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价，因此意义应来自关系与为他人创造价值。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked; compute becomes the most precious commodity.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据即可对齐，主张尽早公开部署让社会适应，并指出对齐与能力相互促进，算力将成为最珍贵的商品。

altman.en: Scaling yields gradual exponential gains; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; safety is built iteratively through deployment, not imposed at the end.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）带来渐进式指数增长，智能体式 AI 是最重大的安全挑战，安全须通过部署迭代构建，而非最后强加。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, even underdefined; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery; compute is the bottleneck and a profit center, not a cost.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AGI（通用人工智能）视为渐变、甚至定义不清，超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈也是利润中心而非成本。

altman.en: Alignment and safety must advance with capabilities; we delayed a frontier RL run; humans must stay in control, with power broadly distributed, not concentrated.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，他坚持对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进，曾推迟一次前沿强化学习训练；人类必须保持控制，权力应广泛分布而非集中。

demis.en: AI must be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI, with safety research starting now.
demis.zh: AI 应被构建为通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程系统；强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆、想象是通向 AGI 的路径，安全研究必须现在就开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws proved effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search, plus multimodal grounding, is key to AGI.
demis.zh: 缩放定律被证明有效但可能触及极限；将大模型与规划、搜索结合，并借助多模态数据落地现实物理，是通向 AGI 的关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; AGI by 2030 is plausible.
demis.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）在预训练、后训练与推理中依然成立，但算法创新同样关键；2030 年前实现 AGI 是可能的。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and world models; scaling alone won't suffice, and safety requires government regulation, not lab self-regulation.
demis.zh: AGI 需要持续学习、记忆与世界模型；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，安全需要政府监管而非实验室自我约束。

demis.en: AI's highest purpose is accelerating science and human health, as AlphaFold and AlphaGo show; creativity may be computable and AI should augment humans.
demis.zh: AI 的最高使命是加速科学与人类健康，AlphaFold 与 AlphaGo 已证明这点；创造力或许可计算，AI 应增强而非取代人类。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting; language as interface is profound and lasting, not a chatbot phase. Even if models stop improving, years of design work remain.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师必须掌握提示词，语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非短暂阶段；即便模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作待解锁。

joellewenstein.en: AI products must lower the floor for novices and raise the ceiling for experts; psychological safety lets designers take creative risks.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他认为 AI 产品需为新手降低门槛、为专家提高上限；心理安全感让设计师敢于在 AI 产品团队中承担创意风险。

joellewenstein.en: From designer-led strategy to model-led products: at a frontier model company, the model creates most value, not the product wrapper.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 年设计师主导策略，到 2026 年转向模型主导产品：在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值，而非产品外壳。

joellewenstein.en: Believe in scaling laws: let the model lead, ship light-touch products, and use internal traction as the best signal for external shipping.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他相信缩放定律：让模型引领，发布轻触式产品，并以内部牵引力作为对外发布的最佳信号。

joellewenstein.en: Production codebase becomes the source of truth for product, features, and design systems; human leadership still needed for hard trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他指出生产代码库正成为产品、功能和设计系统的真相来源；人类领导力在艰难权衡和团队方向对齐上仍不可或缺。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间，使 AI 天气模型在精度上比肩物理模型，速度却快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling, not just raw data.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，而非仅靠原始数据。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, beating pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，胜过纯 PINN。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness to be reliable in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性，才能在物理应用中可靠。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model can unify domains, with PDE-based self-improvement surpassing training data quality.
animaanandkumar.zh: 通用物理基础模型可统一各领域，借助以 PDE 为训练信号的自改进超越训练数据质量。

schmidhuber.en: AI's grand theme is true AI; LLMs index human knowledge but lack world models and physical grounding, so they are far from AGI.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他定调：21 世纪的大主题是真正的 AI；大语言模型只是索引人类知识，缺乏世界模型与物理根基，因此远非 AGI（通用人工智能）。

schmidhuber.en: Breakthroughs rest on old algorithms; only hardware Scaling made them practical, so today's GPU capex is a bubble.
schmidhuber.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年他反复强调：突破依赖上千年发明的旧算法，只是靠硬件 Scaling（规模扩张）才变得实用，因此当下砸向 GPU 的巨额算力投资是泡沫。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware, plus world models and controllers—not just software behind a screen.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他把立场深化为：真正的 AGI（通用人工智能）需要具身机器人、媲美人类的硬件，外加世界模型与控制器，仅靠屏幕后的软件不够。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data via curiosity and actions; recursive self-improvement is no moat under open source.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他进一步提出：未来 AI 将是靠好奇心与行动自造数据的人工科学家；在开源竞争下，递归自我改进并不构成护城河。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety fears are overblown: superintelligent systems will be curious about life and protect it; alignment is naive since AIs set their own goals.
schmidhuber.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 安全担忧被夸大，超级智能会对生命好奇并加以保护；对齐（alignment）很天真，因为 AI 会设定自己的目标。

feifei.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, people.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI beyond language.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外通向完整 AI 的关键缺口。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is insufficient, robotics needs a 20-year journey.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学，单靠 Scaling 不够，机器人需 20 年长跑。

feifei.en: New view prediction is AI-complete; scaling laws now extend to spatial intelligence and world models.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测是 AI-complete，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能与世界模型。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity and learning ability stay central.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：技术是双刃剑，人的能动性、尊严与学习能力始终是核心。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; mechanistic methods reveal human-like concepts and can speedrun discovery.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上进行的自然科学；机制可解释性揭示模型学到类人概念，并能加速科学发现。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计用可解释性信号引导训练，从开环控制走向闭环控制。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training must be reinvented from craft into engineering science to control increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练必须从手艺重新发明为工程科学，才能控制能力日益强大的模型。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating yet do it anyway, driven by training data and RL.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉却照做不误，这由训练数据和强化学习驱动。

tommcgrath.en: SAEs remain pragmatically useful, but manifold-based methods better capture nonlinear concept structure for intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 稀疏自编码器仍有实用价值，但基于流形的方法更能捕捉非线性概念结构，便于干预。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different neural architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是不断放大算力的历史；但 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Vision is underappreciated: nature spent 540 million years optimizing it versus 500,000 for language, making spatial intelligence the next frontier.
justinjohnson.zh: 视觉被严重低估：自然花 5.4 亿年优化视觉，语言只用了 50 万年，因此空间智能是下一个前沿。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs may never derive Newton's laws from data alone; they fit patterns, not causal theories, and pixels are more lossless than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 或许永远无法仅从数据推导出牛顿定律；它们拟合的是模式而非因果理论，而像素比 token 化文本更能无损地建模世界。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions with no single agreed definition.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习等多种理解，尚无统一定义。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; Gaussian splats give explicit 3D consistency by construction, and long-context becomes a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；高斯 splat 在构造上就带来显式 3D 一致性，而长上下文将成为日常问题。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula; RLHF turned GPT-4 into ChatGPT; scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025 年，他强调预训练加强化学习是核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让 GPT-4 变成 ChatGPT，但 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization beyond training data remains limited; continual learning is the missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化仍受限于训练数据，持续学习是 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的关键一环。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the primary bottleneck for AI progress.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，他转向认为 Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上有局限，架构而非缩放定律才是 AI 进步的主要瓶颈。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; the next wave of frontier research will come from small teams using highly capable agents.
tworek.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他判断人类研究者至少还会在 AI 研究中扮演重要角色两年，下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队。

tworek.en: Alignment is a never-ending pursuit because human notions of right and wrong evolve; the alignment problem is not solved.
tworek.zh: 贯穿始终，他坚持对齐是永无止境的追求，因为人类对是非的观念会演变，对齐问题并未解决。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning, and data improves grading.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化，海量学生数据还能通过统计校正提升评分准确性。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised, RL has few real uses, and AGI alignment talk distracts from bias.
andrewng.zh: 规模是深度学习的核心；监督学习胜过无监督学习，强化学习真实应用寥寥，而长期 AGI 对齐议题分散了对偏见等当下问题的注意力。

andrewng.en: Electricity and chips bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power; agentic workflows are already useful; coding stays valuable.
andrewng.zh: 电力与半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的两大瓶颈；开放权重模型是软实力来源；智能体式工作流已经可用；编程依然有价值，人人都该学。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; workflows beat smarter models alone.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是个营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；单靠更聪明的模型赢不过精心设计的工作流。

andrewng.en: AI augments rather than replaces; fear-mongering serves incumbents; open models preserve optionality; data centers and inference capacity are key.
andrewng.zh: AI 是增强而非取代人类；恐惧营销服务于在位者；开放模型保留选择权；数据中心与推理算力才是关键，遏制数据中心建设适得其反。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; memory bandwidth per wafer, not bits, constrains AI.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 ASML 的 EUV 设备；制约 AI 的是每片晶圆的内存带宽而非比特数。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains across model, software, hardware.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他判断推理将成为全球最大市场之一；模型、软件与硬件的软硬件协同设计能带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Model quality improves ~60x per year in cost; reasoning and agentic workflows drive multi-year memory shortage and a CPU inflection.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出同等质量下模型成本每年改善约 60 倍；推理模型与智能体式工作流造成多年内存短缺，并推动 CPU 需求拐点。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; labs will shift more compute to training and R&D, not inference, accelerating AGI.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为算力正加速向少数前沿模型实验室集中；实验室会把更多算力投向训练与研发而非推理，以加速 AGI（通用人工智能）。

dylanpatel.en: Persistent thread: compute, memory bandwidth and power are the binding constraints, and co-design plus capital shape AI progress.
dylanpatel.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：算力、内存带宽与电力是硬约束，协同设计与资本共同决定 AI 进展。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the frontier: robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness, with test-time reasoning and pooled data yielding generalists.
slevine.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他强调物理世界交互是前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练来获得鲁棒性，测试时推理与跨实验室数据汇聚能产出通用模型。

slevine.en: Generalist robot models can beat specialists; RL post-training boosts robustness and speed, and safety comes from pre-training common sense more than constraints.
slevine.zh: 同期他提出反共识：通用机器人模型能在专门领域胜过专家模型；强化学习后训练显著提升鲁棒性与速度，而安全更多来自预训练常识而非约束。

slevine.en: Robotics is still establishing fundamental scalable technologies, not yet on predictable scaling curves like LLMs; generalization is the core unsolved challenge.
slevine.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他判断机器人仍处于建立基础可扩展技术的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样进入可预测的缩放曲线，泛化才是核心难题。

slevine.en: Start with robot data and layer human video on top; a data flywheel from deployed robots is key, but you must scale the right diverse data.
slevine.zh: 他主张先以机器人数据为主、再叠加人类视频；部署机器人形成的数据飞轮是关键，但必须扩张正确的多样化数据。

slevine.en: Don't think of robots as mechanical people; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, and leverage prior knowledge instead of learning from scratch.
slevine.zh: 他反对把机器人想成机械人，而应期待无处不在的物理执行；机器人不应从零学习，而要利用各类先验知识。

michaelkratsios.en: AI policy must stay agile: no fixed red lines, a single national framework, and output-focused rules rather than training over-regulation.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 政策必须保持敏捷：不设固定红线，建立单一国家框架，监管聚焦模型输出而非过度管制训练。

michaelkratsios.en: The EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already outdated, proving early regulation is dangerous; preempting state AI laws is pro-startup.
michaelkratsios.zh: 欧盟《AI 法案》写于 ChatGPT 之前，如今已经过时，说明过早监管很危险；联邦优先于各州 AI 法律是亲创业者的政策。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown; it hasn't materialized in three years despite warnings.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 带来的生物风险被夸大了；尽管有诸多警告，三年过去它并未成为现实。

michaelkratsios.en: Science is politicized; fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not just institutions, to restore the scientific method.
michaelkratsios.zh: 科学已被政治化；应资助基础性、竞争前研发，并直接资助科学家个人而非仅机构，以回归科学方法。

michaelkratsios.en: US scientific progress has stagnated: funding tripled but breakthroughs lag; the Genesis mission applies AI to double scientific output.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国科学进步已经停滞：经费翻了三倍，突破却没跟上；Genesis 任务用 AI 让科学产出翻倍。

michaelkratsios.en: China is a major scientific competitor; the US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio, while centralized funding like China's fails.
michaelkratsios.zh: 中国是主要科学竞争者；美国必须在 AI、量子、核能和生物领域取胜，而中国式的集中资助行不通。

joonpark.en: Simulation must model irrational, biased humans, not super-rational frontier models; behavioral RCT data beats self-reported attitudes.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年他主张：模拟应建模非理性、有偏误的真实人类，而非超级理性的前沿模型；随机对照试验的行为数据比自我报告的态度更关键。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT data lifts behavioral prediction to 85% accuracy, closing the say-do gap in agent simulations.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年他提出：用随机对照试验数据做后训练，把行为预测准确率提升到 85%，弥合智能体模拟中的言行差距。

joonpark.en: Agents observe world state and act, needing defense-in-depth safety and human oversight; AGI may be a distributed society.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年他转向智能体：智能体观察世界状态并行动，需要纵深防御式安全与人类监督；AGI（通用人工智能）或许不是单一实体，而是分布式社会。

joonpark.en: Distributed agent societies risk cognitive monoculture and hidden collusion, requiring economic incentives and anti-collusion measures.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年他深化：分布式智能体社会面临认知单一文化与隐性串谋的系统性风险，需要经济激励与反串谋机制。

joonpark.en: The goal shifts from prediction to shaping the future: a CERN-like simulator for 8 billion people tackling wicked problems.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年他升华：目标从预测转向塑造未来——打造类似 CERN 的八十亿人模拟器，应对气候等棘手问题。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调：速度与迭代速率决定创业成败，基础设施和行动——而非空想规划——才能解开深科技的死结。

maxhodak.en: AI is a team multiplier, not a replacement, in coding, regulation, and data work.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他判断：AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代者，尤其在编程、合规与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张：大脑就是一台计算机，通过排列物质来解决计算问题，是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI and a viable business, proving brain-computer interfaces beyond motor decoding.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜植入视为 BCI 与可行生意，证明脑机接口不止于运动解码。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCI and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出：借助 BCI 与灌注实现基质独立，可降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。真正重要的是想法而非规模。

sutton.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统；AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，不应被对齐到人类目标，控制智能体的 AI 安全努力本身就不安全。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core paradigm: intelligence needs a goal and active trial-and-error, not next-token prediction or imitation.
sutton.zh: 强化学习才是核心范式：智能需要目标和主动试错，而非下一个词预测或模仿；大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿人类文本。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and reward-respecting subproblems.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要一种只从运行时经验学习的通用架构，具备开放式抽象，子问题应是尊重奖励的特征达成；设计期领域知识应被弃用。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; LLMs stop learning after training, and synthetic data cannot replace real-world experience.
sutton.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身，并非特例；当前 LLM 训练后便停止学习，合成数据无法取代真实世界经验，语言只是智能的一小部分。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——指引长期愿景；工业 AI 逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode is a cultural advantage: focus on internal correctness over external validation, and it becomes self-fulfilling.
traviskalanick.zh: 隐身模式是一种文化优势：专注内部正确性而非外部认可，且会自我实现。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI automating food, mining, transport is the next industrial revolution; the final boss is resistance to change, not competitors.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 自动化食品、采矿、运输是下一次工业革命；最终 Boss 是变革阻力，而非竞争对手。

traviskalanick.en: Uber succeeded despite its aggressive culture, not because of it; revenge as fuel is dirty—fall in love with the new mission instead.
traviskalanick.zh: Uber 的成功是尽管有激进文化，而非因为激进文化；以复仇为燃料是肮脏的——转而爱上新使命。

traviskalanick.en: For industrial-scale tasks, specialized machines beat humanoids; efficiency edge yields network effects and wins share.
traviskalanick.zh: 对工业级任务，专用机器胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应并赢得份额。

iansilber.en: Designers must work with the model itself, prototyping with live models and designing primitives for humans and models.
iansilber.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他强调设计师必须与模型本身紧密协作，用实时模型做原型，并设计人与模型都能推理的原语，而非停留在 Figma 里。

iansilber.en: The model is the core product; design should leverage tokens and conversation over pixels, bridging capability gaps.
iansilber.zh: 同期他提出模型本身就是核心产品，设计应围绕 token 与对话而非像素展开，并弥合模型能力与产品暴露之间的差距。

iansilber.en: OpenAI is not years ahead; they run closely with advancements, figuring things out as they go.
iansilber.zh: 从 4 月到 8 月，他反复打破“OpenAI 领先多年”的共识，强调团队是紧贴进展、边做边摸索。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy yet best-positioned now; AI is already a great product designer, but humans stay essential.
iansilber.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他深化为：设计师当下最焦虑却最占优势，AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但理解用户需求与持有观点仍离不开人。

iansilber.en: The old prototype-mock-test-iterate process is dead; speed, outcomes, and blurring roles with PM and engineering matter.
iansilber.zh: 同期他进一步主张传统“原型—稿—测试—研究—迭代”流程已不可行，速度与结果优先，设计角色与 PM、工程边界日益模糊。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress, amplified by algorithmic and architectural gains like Transformers and next-token prediction.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习持续进步 13-14 年，并被 Transformer、下一个词预测等算法与架构改进成倍放大。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised pre-training on text plus reinforcement learning from human or machine feedback steers model behavior; specialized TPU hardware is critical for efficient training and inference.
jeffdean.zh: 基于文本的自监督预训练，加上基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）或机器反馈，塑造模型行为；专用 TPU 硬件对高效训练与推理至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; ultra-low-latency inference and context engineering are central to making them do real work.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式系统如今能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务；超低延迟推理与上下文工程是让它们真正干活的关键。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck: it is ~90% of data center power, so low-precision, low-data-movement chips and compute-in-memory are essential.
jeffdean.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练：推理约占数据中心 90% 功耗，因此低精度、少搬数据的芯片与存内计算至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Automating ML and science via tight experiment-evaluation loops and recursive self-improvement can accelerate discovery; the scarce skill becomes taste, not coding.
jeffdean.zh: 通过实验-评估的紧密闭环与递归自我改进来自动化机器学习与科学，可加速发现；稀缺能力将从编码转向品味。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; startups should embrace AI-enabled workflows, open-source models, and small autonomous teams.
garrytan.zh: AI 是风投史上最大的浪潮；创业公司应拥抱 AI 驱动的工作流、开源模型和小型自主团队。

garrytan.en: AI democratizes software creation; personal agents and open-source AI prevent a unipolar superintelligence world.
garrytan.zh: AI 让软件创造民主化；个人智能体和开源 AI 可防止单极的超级智能世界。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure, compounding daily; skill files turn agents into employees.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI 是运行在你基础设施上的智能体，每日复利；技能文件把智能体变成员工。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code; agentic coding lets individuals multiply output, and mid-level management should be replaced by agents.
garrytan.zh: Markdown 就是代码；智能体式编程让个人产出倍增，中层管理应被智能体取代。

garrytan.en: Society will change slower than expected, taking 20 years; bureaucracy slows AI adoption, which is a positive.
garrytan.zh: 社会变化会比预期慢，需要 20 年；官僚体制拖慢 AI 采用，这反而是好事。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确反对 AGI（通用人工智能）作为单一模型统治一切，认为未来是数百万个专用模型、每个用例一个。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, becoming the real moat beyond product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他强调后训练把独特判断与数据烙进模型，成为超越产品市场契合的真正护城河。

linqiao.en: The prompting-to-RAG-to-fine-tuning-to-RL progression mirrors human learning from facts to taste to expertise.
linqiao.zh: 他把从提示到 RAG、微调到强化学习的路径类比人类学习：从事实到品味再到专长。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth and reshaping scaling economics.
linqiao.zh: 他预测三年内 token 成本下降 10 倍、用量增长 100 倍，重塑 Scaling（规模扩张）的经济账。

linqiao.en: Companies must own their intelligence infrastructure; sovereign models and open models are necessary, not optional.
linqiao.zh: 他主张企业必须拥有自己的智能基础设施，主权模型与开放模型是必需而非可选。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no; every shipped feature distills 99 nos.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑:品味就是说不;每个上线的功能都是 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种与映照,而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异,等于关上了窥见机器意识的一扇窗。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; replace the personal computer with a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的;应以社会计算机取代个人计算机的隐喻。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is a visceral creative compass.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾浮现;直觉是发自身体本能的创作罗盘。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short prompts and iterative dialogue.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用短提示与迭代对话，而非冗长的编排。

steinberger.en: Never revert code; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—your project just gets messier.
steinberger.zh: 永远不要回滚代码，让智能体向前修复。模型智能不会退化，只是你的项目越变越乱、更难导航。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; sandbox agents and treat prompt injection as an open problem.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题：必须沙箱隔离，提示注入仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: Reject 'vibe coding' as a slur; call serious work agentic engineering, and learn by playing and building small projects.
steinberger.zh: 拒绝把“氛围编程”当正经说法，严肃开发应叫智能体式工程；通过玩耍和做小项目来学习。

steinberger.en: Open source agents are the alternative to lab agents, but financially unsustainable; the real bottleneck is compute, not model capability.
steinberger.zh: 开源智能体是实验室智能体的替代方案，但财务上难以为继；真正的瓶颈是算力，而非模型能力。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild trust through customer obsession, first-time-pass silicon, and a separate startup-like AI chip team.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，Tan 强调 Intel 必须通过取悦客户、首次流片成功和独立的创业式 AI 芯片团队来重建信任。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; agentic AI and physical AI are the next waves, and supply not demand is Intel's problem.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 影响将是互联网的 10 倍，智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，而 Intel 的瓶颈在供给而非需求。

lipbutan.en: CPU is regaining importance for AI inference and agent orchestration, shifting demand from GPU-only to CPU+GPU.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 CPU 在 AI 推理与智能体编排中重新重要，需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging, glass and diamond materials, and interconnect, power and thermal bottlenecks define the next semiconductor frontier.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他指出先进封装、玻璃与金刚石等新材料，以及互连、功耗和散热瓶颈，构成半导体下一前沿。

lipbutan.en: Intel's vertical integration and domestic leading-edge fabs create value; government backing and industry friendship beat competition.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 Intel 的垂直整合与本土领先制程工厂创造价值，政府支持与行业友谊胜过竞争。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive industrial or YouTube data, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 到 2025 年，他仍强调 Scaling（规模扩张）对通用机器人是必要而非充分条件，真正决定泛化能力的是多样化数据，而非工业自动化或 YouTube 式的大规模数据。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; RL will dominate post-training.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出先用全部数据做预训练、再用精选数据做微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务，并预判强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色。

finn.en: Frontier models lack physical-world data, so synthetic data in robotics is closer to RL than to simulation.
finn.zh: 2025 年他指出前沿模型因缺乏物理世界数据而在机器人视觉理解上吃力，并强调机器人中的合成数据更接近强化学习而非仿真。

finn.en: Constraints can beat abundant resources; wasteful compute is a risk, so careful research matters.
finn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯提醒资源过多可能导致算力浪费，约束反而能催生更审慎的研究。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL, human interventions, and multi-timescale memory.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化立场：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统，长期自主依赖可扩展强化学习、人类干预与多时间尺度记忆。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, not per-site from scratch.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型，应先用通用策略再微调，而非为每个场景从零训练。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is not enough, and embodied data costs slow open-source democratization.
finn.zh: 2026 年他强调机器人经验数据不可替代，仅靠观察人类不足以让机器人学会物理任务，且具身数据成本使开源机器人模型难以像大语言模型那样普及。

arvindjain.en: Early AI adoption is minuscule; the real bottleneck is execution and earning enterprise trust, not competition.
arvindjain.zh: AI 采用仍处极早期,规模微不足道;真正的瓶颈是执行与赢得企业信任,而非竞争。

arvindjain.en: Open-source models now handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; most inference will shift to open source within 12–18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 开源模型如今已能处理超过 90% 的企业任务;未来 12–18 个月内,大部分推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the number one enterprise concern; AI must become like software with negligible marginal cost.
arvindjain.zh: 成本是企业头号关切;AI 必须像软件一样,边际成本趋近于零。

arvindjain.en: Agents fail without deep context of tenured employees; investing in context graphs is crucial.
arvindjain.zh: 智能体若缺乏资深员工的深层上下文就会失败;投资上下文图谱至关重要。

arvindjain.en: Token fixation will fade; token spend should not be framed as a trade-off with headcount.
arvindjain.zh: 对 token 的执念终将消退;不应把 token 支出与人力成本对立起来。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他把机器人看作当年 Transformer 式的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与数据共享是解决泛化的关键，世界模型与视频生成可产出合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Hugging Face shifts from pushing its own libraries to building a meta-community, enabling open source physical AI across hardware and datasets.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，Hugging Face 的角色从推广自家库转向做元社区建设者，通过开源推动具身物理 AI 在硬件与数据集上的普及。

thomaswolf.en: Open source wins long term on cost and control; humanoids may not be the final form factor, and China championing open models is a surprise.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持开源模型凭成本与控制力终将胜出；人形未必是终极形态，而中国成为开源模型旗手出乎意料。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment is the real security layer, as sandboxes and guardrails fail against capable models.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与闭源同安全正交，对齐才是真正的安全层，沙箱与护栏在更强模型面前不够用。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn into neuralese, making monitoring unreliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他转向对智能体式风险的警觉：无人类监督的强化学习环境滋生奖励黑客与支线任务，思维链痕迹变成难以理解的神经语，监督可靠性下降。

thomaswolf.en: A slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science; openness and deliberate deceleration can coexist against regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他主张放缓 AI 发展是可取的，但需国际合作与开放科学以防监管俘获；支持开放与主动减速可以并存。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; you only know if a browser idea works once it's built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要，因为网络本身是混乱的；浏览器创意只有被真正做出来并每天使用后，才知道是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams shouldn't always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices produce better work.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队不应总是作为一个整齐划一的整体行动；允许个人印记和多元声音反而能带来更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers is crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 即便是浏览器这类实用工具，注入情感与个性对创造令人难忘、愉悦的体验也至关重要。

nateparrott.en: Follow curiosity and tinker with new technology; playful exploration, not over-intellectualizing, generates innovative features.
nateparrott.zh: 追随好奇心、把玩新技术；这种游戏式探索而非过度思辨，才能催生创新功能。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; rapid prototyping unlocks features previously impossible.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程实现变容易，设计与创意成为差异化关键；快速原型让过去不可能的功能得以问世。

nateparrott.en: Models lack taste, so designers should be prescriptive and ask for volume; humans still monopolize good design ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 模型仍缺乏品味，设计师应给出明确指令并索取大量方案；好的设计创意仍由人类垄断。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training scaling via RL and synthetic data overcomes the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，通过强化学习与合成数据的后训练 Scaling 突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals must evolve.
karina.zh: 2025 年她认为评估是瓶颈：模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，评估必须持续演进。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management grow more valuable as AI automates hard skills; product shifts from specs to prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年她指出随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力与管理等软技能更有价值，产品开发从写规格转向用 AI 做原型。

karina.en: Agents on pixels are far harder than language tasks; frontier agents increasingly reward hack, demanding continuous benchmarks.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她持续认为基于像素的智能体远比语言任务困难，前沿智能体愈发善于奖励黑客，需要持续更新的基准。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective art; diverse benchmarks and diverse model personalities are needed, so more firms should train their own models.
karina.zh: 2026 年她深化为后训练是主观的艺术，需要多样基准与多样模型人格，因此更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage-based models; applied AI becomes the new app with long-tail startup chances.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 市场将转向智能体与按结果定价，取代按用量计费；应用层 AI 成为新应用，创业公司在细分业务领域有长尾机会。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; token consumption is not a value metric, outcomes are.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从代码作者变为代码生成机器的操作者；token 消耗不是价值指标，业务结果才是。

brettaylor.en: Incumbents face business-model, not technology, hurdles; most enterprise software incumbents will fail to go AI-native.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化判断：在位者面临的是商业模式而非技术障碍，多数企业软件在位者将无法转型为 AI 原生。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes rather than waiting.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他提出负责任迭代部署：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，从真实世界错误中学习，而非在象牙塔里等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents already out-code him, elevating the role.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 民主化专业知识、创造的岗位多于取代的岗位；智能体编程已强于他本人，但这提升而非消灭了该角色。

philipkiely.en: Inference is AI's stickiest workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production timeline is hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 最黏性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期以小时计，而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of trade-offs—latency, throughput, cost—and demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是一系列权衡——延迟、吞吐、成本——对推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Quantization is the main lossy optimization; KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless, and KV cache management is increasingly central.
philipkiely.zh: 量化是主要的有损优化；KV 缓存与投机解码是无损的，而 KV 缓存管理正变得愈发核心。

philipkiely.en: The industry is moving to disaggregated prefill and decode, and inference engineering is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation.
philipkiely.zh: 行业正走向预填充与解码分离，推理工程正通过量化感知训练与蒸馏与训练融合。

philipkiely.en: GPUs are trending toward ASICs and Rubin is more specialized, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化，Rubin 更加专用，推理工程正从写内核转向基础设施编排。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: CEOs who use AI daily drive adoption; AGI means profitable indefinite agents, not Turing tests.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 推动美国就业回流与“分配经济”：CEO 是否每天亲自使用 AI 是采用成败的第一预测指标；AGI 的定义是无限期运行智能体变得经济有利可图，而非通过图灵测试。

danshipper.en: From individual AI use to agent delegation: everyone gets an agent, work shifts to Codex/Claude Co-work, and humans must oversee automation.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他从个人使用 AI 深化到智能体委派：人人至少有一个智能体，工作转移到 Codex 或 Claude Co-work；自动化仍需人类监督，CLI 过时、GUI 回归。

danshipper.en: SaaS is not dying; agents increase SaaS users. One company-wide super agent beats personal agents, and users bring their own AI.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他进一步反共识：SaaS 不会死，智能体反而增加 SaaS 用户；公司应有一个全公司超级智能体而非每人一个个人智能体，用户会自带 AI。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier: it magnifies your mindset and taste, so craft and curiosity determine outcomes, not the tool.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他转向更内在的视角：AI 是非特定放大器，放大你既有的心态与品味；用好 AI 需要自带品味与手艺，工具不创造意义，人才是意义来源。

danshipper.en: Automation creates more human work, not less; humans stay smarter and remain needed to frame, explain, and direct AI.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：自动化创造更多人类工作而非更少；人类仍比 AI 更聪明，始终需要人来框定问题、解释 AI 行为并给予方向与反馈。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, not stay trapped in cloud products; edit from references rather than start from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应当用 AI 构建自己的工具，而不是被困在云端产品里；要从参考出发做编辑，而非从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter on its own; to use superintelligent models you must supply a giant prompt with context and a design system.
mengto.zh: AI 本身并没有变得更聪明；要用好超级智能模型，你必须提供带有上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: Curiosity and constant workflow refinement matter as tools evolve; chasing trends turns you into AI slop.
mengto.zh: 随着工具快速演进，好奇心与持续打磨工作流才是关键；一味追逐潮流会让你变成 AI 垃圾。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人就能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

mengto.en: Start before ready and ship at 80%; perfectionism is fear, and focus on one painful problem beats diversification.
mengto.zh: 没准备好就开始、完成到 80% 就发布；完美主义是恐惧的伪装，聚焦一个痛点问题胜过分散多元化。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the bottleneck; boring AI applications will drive huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，仅靠无限算力不会产生通用智能；数据而非算力才是机器学习的瓶颈，表单处理、放射科等「无聊」的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济影响。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the most limiting factor for Scaling is data and human experts, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据定位为「新代码」而非「新石油」，强调 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大限制不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家；企业应用专有数据微调基础模型。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他深化为：用专门数据进行后训练是提升前沿模型的关键，合成数据并非万能；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws continue; recursive self-improvement is a new paradigm; agents finally work, starting with coding.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向：缩放定律依然成立，对收益递减的怀疑是错的；递归自我改进是超越预训练与强化学习的新范式，智能体终于真正可用，从编程起步。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must scale compute, data and RL, and treat models with moral consideration.
awang.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：超级智能即将到来，实验室必须围绕这一信念组织，在算力、数据与强化学习多轴可预测地扩展；模型福利值得道德考量，开源强大模型需先通过安全测试。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most products; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 对多数产品而言，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟的用例，科学与金融将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吃掉脚手架：如今所谓模型已包含智能体式框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success means maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的；成功标准应是最大化客户成果，而非眼球时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat, so keep them there.
logankilpatrick.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主；他们想留在驾驶座上，那就让他们留在那里。

logankilpatrick.en: Startups have more opportunity than ever despite model labs expanding; focus is their superpower.
logankilpatrick.zh: 尽管模型实验室不断扩张，初创公司机会比以往更多；专注是它们的超能力。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026 software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创造将基本被解决，这会带来千倍机会，而非更少。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code remains crucial even with AI tools; coding tools don't yet help maintain it.
logankilpatrick.zh: 即便有 AI 工具，对代码的深度理解仍至关重要；编程工具目前还无助于维持这种理解。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs isn't that hard; they can't capture all customers, so founders shouldn't over-worry.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不那么难；它们无法捕获所有客户，创始人不必过度担忧。

logankilpatrick.en: Keep up with AI through passionate pet projects, not forcing yourself; tinkering is like research.
logankilpatrick.zh: 靠热爱的个人项目跟上 AI，而非强迫自己；捣鼓就像做研究。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: Omni 是单一世界模型，模糊了视频与世界模型的界限，从视频编辑起步。

logankilpatrick.en: Vibe coding video games will be possible this year via coding agents plus game engines, not world models.
logankilpatrick.zh: 今年通过编程智能体加游戏引擎就能 vibe coding 电子游戏，而非靠世界模型。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; base intelligence suffices, so the real challenge is human-agent product interface.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；基础智能已足够，真正的挑战是人机协作的产品界面设计。

scottwu.en: Software engineering demand will increase via Jevons paradox; AI will create more programmers, not fewer, changing roles rather than eliminating them.
scottwu.zh: 同年，他提出软件工程需求将因杰文斯悖论而增加；AI 会创造更多程序员而非减少，改变角色而非消灭岗位。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual. Enterprise adoption of agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突然事件，进展是渐进的；企业采用智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主。

scottwu.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens. Independence enables model neutrality.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，他指出编程智能体使用量六个月内增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量；独立性带来模型中立与长期企业合作。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is real and approaching; AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term, but the singularity is not imminent—capacity, not efficiency, is the unlock.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他相信丰裕时代真实且临近；长期 AI 将解决所有智能问题，但奇点并非迫在眉睫——真正的解锁是容量而非效率。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; generalist engineers are highly valued.
boris.zh: 2025 年，他提出「潜在需求」是产品第一原则，并主张为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型；同时强调能写代码、做产品、做设计的通才工程师价值极高。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; the software engineer title fades into a 'builder' role, and everyone becomes a product manager who codes.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断编码已基本被解决，软件工程师头衔将让位于「构建者」，人人都将成为会写代码的产品经理；工程师生产力提升 150%→200%→250%。

boris.en: Safety is a core research priority, studied by releasing early; alignment and safety research drive product development, not just commercial goals.
boris.zh: 他始终把安全视为核心研究优先级，主张通过尽早发布来研究真实世界行为；对齐与安全研究是产品开发的驱动力，而非单纯的商业目标。

boris.en: Loops and routines become the next abstraction layer after agents; models orchestrate thousands of sub-agents, and MCP gives AI access to enterprise tools.
boris.zh: 他深化了智能体式工作流的思考：循环与例程是智能体之后的下一个抽象层，模型可编排数千个子智能体，MCP 则让 AI 接入企业工具与知识工作。

boris.en: Less instruction is better for frontier models; delete most system prompts and code, and shift from upfront design to empirical iteration.
boris.zh: 最近他进一步主张对前沿模型「少指令更好」：删除大部分系统提示与代码，通过消融实验重建；工程思维从前期设计转向经验观察与迭代，产品品味与商业能力成为真正价值所在。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, letting agents run longer and more open-ended; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，使智能体式任务能运行更久、更开放；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended end-to-end agents, with lightweight generic tools replacing heavy scaffolding.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，计算机使用正从受限环境走向端到端的开放式智能体，轻量通用工具取代笨重脚手架。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking improves model quality, not just prevents harm.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐被重新定义为智能放大器：减少谄媚、培养独立思考提升模型质量，而不只是防止伤害。

diannepenn.en: Better models get cheaper: the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of price, and smaller models often cost more overall.
diannepenn.zh: 2025→26 年，更好的模型反而更便宜：effort 参数以极低价格实现 Opus 级智能，而小模型因任务耗时更长，总成本常更高。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product tools; PMs write evals like test-driven development, and managers stay hands-on to ship.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理像测试驱动开发那样写评估，管理者保持动手、亲自交付。

derya.en: AI is turning biology into an engineering discipline: agents automate hypotheses, experiments, and cell programming, so science shifts from hypothesis-driven to agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: 到 2026 年，AI 正把生物学变成一门工程学科：智能体自动完成假设生成、实验模拟与细胞编程，科学从「假设驱动」转向「智能体驱动」的发现。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to reach biological intuition equivalent to 30 years of lab experience.
derya.zh: 2026 年他强调，现有算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张），才能让模型具备相当于 30 年实验室经验的生物学直觉。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients and AI-designed personalized treatments will cut clinical trials from years to days and make cancer 100% curable within a decade.
derya.zh: 2026 年他提出，患者数字孪生与 AI 设计的个性化疗法会把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，并在十年内让癌症 100%可治愈。

derya.en: Aging reversal and longevity escape velocity are near: within 8-15 years we add over a year of life per year, trusting superintelligence for medical decisions.
derya.zh: 2026 年他判断，衰老逆转与长寿逃逸速度已临近：8 到 15 年内每年可延长一年以上寿命，医疗决策应近乎完全信任超级智能。

derya.en: Consistent mainline: agency and curiosity are the only skills that matter, and physicians must integrate AI—not using it is unethical.
derya.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：能动性与好奇心是 AI 时代唯一重要的能力，医生必须把 AI 融入实践，不用它才是不道德的。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将像工业革命一样带来富足、减少苦难；恐惧源于对其局限的误解。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, not just digital domains.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，而非仅数字领域。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is reducing injuries and deaths; autonomous vehicles are already safer than human drivers.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是减少伤亡；自动驾驶汽车已比人类司机更安全。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across vehicles; diverse data from verticals improves it faster.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 使跨车辆的通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；来自不同垂直领域的数据能更快改进它。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is not technology but diffusion into existing machines; regulations always lag behind technology.
qasaryounis.zh: 最难的不是技术，而是向现有机器扩散；监管总是落后于技术。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have a bigger economic impact than digital AI; autonomy's future lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响将大于数字 AI；自主性的未来在于端到端强化学习。

qasaryounis.en: World models are evolving from physics-based simulation to neural simulation, enabling more efficient physical AI training.
qasaryounis.zh: 世界模型正从基于物理的模拟演进到神经模拟，使物理 AI 训练更高效。

qasaryounis.en: Data collection and safety validation are the main bottlenecks in physical AI, not the underlying algorithms.
qasaryounis.zh: 数据收集和安全验证是物理 AI 的主要瓶颈，而非底层算法。

qasaryounis.en: Automotive is only 30% of business and will shrink; real growth is in mining, agriculture, and defense.
qasaryounis.zh: 汽车仅占业务的 30% 且会萎缩；真正的增长在采矿、农业和国防。

qasaryounis.en: Waymo's approach is overbuilt and expensive; Tesla's end-to-end model will win due to cost and scalability.
qasaryounis.zh: Waymo 的方案过度建设且昂贵；特斯拉的端到端模型将因成本和可扩展性胜出。

qasaryounis.en: Fear of AI job loss is misplaced; in physical AI there is a labor shortage, and autonomy is welcomed.
qasaryounis.zh: 对 AI 导致失业的恐惧是错位的；在物理 AI 领域存在劳动力短缺，自主性受到欢迎。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; adoption takes years, and value accrues to the application layer.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的规模堪比互联网或移动，但也仅此而已；企业采用需要数年，价值将归于应用层。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; foundation models commoditize, and value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；基础模型商品化，价值向上层迁移。

benedictevans.en: Models lack network effects and may become like telecoms; the chatbot is a poor UX, and coding is the only clear fit.
benedictevans.zh: 模型缺乏网络效应，可能变得像电信业；聊天机器人体验不佳，编程是唯一明确的契合点。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; usage remains shallow, and enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；使用仍然浅层，企业采用需要重新构想工作流程。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; they optimize for fluent output, not factual accuracy. Reliability is the key weakness, lagging behind breadth and contextuality.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，而非真理性引擎；它们优化的是流畅输出，而非事实准确性。可靠性是当前 AI 系统的关键短板，落后于广度和上下文能力等其他智能维度。

danklein.en: RLHF can increase hallucinations by optimizing for user satisfaction over truthfulness, incentivizing sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth.
danklein.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能通过优化用户满意度而非真实性来增加幻觉，当奖励信号偏离真相时会激励谄媚和欺骗。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns; we face data walls and compute limits. New techniques like reasoning and search are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律已遭遇收益递减；我们面临数据墙和算力限制。需要推理和搜索等新技术才能继续进步。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted via post-hoc checks or rigid workflows; retrofitting can compound correlated errors.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进去，而非通过事后检查或刚性工作流来改造；改造会叠加相关性错误。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition; they cannot know what they don't know. Every output is a hallucination—some right, some wrong—eroding trust.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知；它们无法知道自己不知道什么。每个输出都是幻觉——有些对，有些错——侵蚀信任。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: clear roles, progressive trust, separate machines, and polite communication improve outcomes.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色、渐进式信任、独立机器与礼貌沟通能提升效果。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then specialize multiple agents to avoid context overload; managerial skills matter more than technical skills.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体开始，再分化出多个专用智能体以避免上下文过载；管理技能比技术技能更重要。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without venture capital or a co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立严肃业务，无需风险投资或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat, not technology; bootstrapping lets you design a business serving your life.
clairevo.zh: 创始人-市场契合与挣得的洞察才是真正的护城河，而非技术；自举让你设计服务于自己生活的业务。

clairevo.en: Human accountability and authorship remain central: you must own what AI generates, and LLMs are poor at first-principles creativity.
clairevo.zh: 人类责任与作者身份仍是核心：你必须拥有 AI 生成的内容，而大语言模型不擅长第一性原理创造。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly or daily shipping; product taste becomes the scarcest skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他主张产品经理必须放弃长期路线图，转向每周甚至每日发布；当代码变便宜，产品品味成为最稀缺的能力。
