catwu.en: Safe AGI as a shared mission unifies Anthropic and enables fast cross-org decisions; clear goals and principles empower autonomous teams.
catwu.zh: 同期，他把安全 AGI 视为统一 Anthropic 的使命，使跨组织快速决策成为可能；清晰的目标与原则让团队自主决策、快速交付。

catwu.en: Automations must reach 100% reliability, not 95%; 95% is not enough for real leverage.
catwu.zh: 从 2026 年 4 月到 7 月，他坚持自动化必须做到 100% 可靠，95% 不足以产生真正的杠杆效应。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense; Claude Tag lands 65% of product PRs.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他认为编码智能体让工程师把实现委托出去，专注于产品品味与商业判断；Claude Tag 已落地 65% 的产品 PR。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good: a codebase is a spec, and with a good test suite rewriting is fine; humans can leave the outer-layer code review loop.
catwu.zh: 同期，他反共识地认为重写现在是好事：代码库就是规格说明，有好的测试套件重写就没问题；外层变更可以把人类移出代码审查循环。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不是原始智能,而是学习不断演化的上下文;记忆必须内化进模型权重,而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割;把事实内化进权重才能实现联想式召回与更深层的组合推理,这是检索系统做不到的。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; per-team or per-user models cut inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型,而是众多个性化模型;按团队或按用户训练模型,相比 RAG 能把推理成本降低数个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; scaling with more compute is not the only path—the next paradigm requires doing more with less.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割;靠更多算力做 Scaling（规模扩张）并非唯一路径,下一个范式要求以更少资源做更多事。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'; continual learning should run on-device, with users owning and nurturing their own model weights.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”,token 越多准确率反而下降;持续学习应跑在端侧,由用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste, variation, and genuine voice become the differentiator as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量商品化，人的品味、差异与真实声音成为差异化关键。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and over-reliance breaks the talent pipeline and apprenticeship.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专长使他们误用 AI，过度依赖更会破坏人才梯队与学徒制。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long-running tasks independently, shifting beyond back-and-forth chatbot prompting.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体式时代：AI 独立执行长时任务，超越来回提示的聊天机器人交互。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck is no longer capability but interface; current interfaces lag behind frontier model capabilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈不再是能力而是界面；当前界面落后于前沿模型能力，尤其在非编程任务上。

ethanmollick.en: Working with AI is like working with wizards: impressive, opaque, unverifiable, and this opacity is likely permanent; embrace the weirdness.
ethanmollick.zh: 与 AI 协作如同与巫师共事：惊艳、不透明、不可验证，且这种不透明可能永久存在；应拥抱其怪异而非将其正常化。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is just pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年时他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 2020 年他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，与长期的人玩长期的游戏才能获得复利。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown and open-source AI prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年他转向认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，末日论被夸大，开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps, and pure software is becoming uninvestable.
naval.zh: 2026 年他深化为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，氛围编程让非程序员也能构建应用，纯软件正变得不可投资。

naval.en: Happiness is a skill and a choice; desire causes unhappiness, and the journey matters more than success.
naval.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：幸福是一种技能和选择，欲望带来不幸，旅程比成功更重要。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous amid population decline, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，而人类劳动者将变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models may lack durable moats as they commoditize.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的一个脚注，而模型可能因快速商品化而缺乏持久护城河。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often a bias of disconnected intellectuals.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；悲观听起来更高级，但往往是与现实脱节的知识分子的偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models are not objective; they embed cultural and historical values, making them geopolitical tools, and Silicon Valley cannot be replicated elsewhere.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型并非客观；它们嵌入了文化与历史价值观，因而成为地缘政治工具，而硅谷无法在别处被复制。

andreessen.en: New media makes the brand the person; authenticity and picking the right fights build brands, while corporate brands only made sense in the centralized media era.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让品牌即个人；真实性与选对战场能塑造品牌，而企业品牌只在中心化媒体时代才说得通。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder, though productivity gains on established codebases stay modest.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，让人人都成为产品构建者，但在成熟代码库上的生产力提升仍然有限。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view matter more as AI outputs become starting points; direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting, and design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 随着 AI 产出沦为起点，品味、手艺与观点愈发重要；在画布上直接操作胜过提示词，设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Despite talk of role merging, we see merging of responsibilities, not roles; human judgment stays the judge, and AI won't replace jobs.
dylanfield.zh: 尽管有角色融合的说法，实际发生的是职责融合而非角色融合；人类判断仍是裁判，AI 不会取代工作。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important than ever for scalable systems; AI without human steering and a point of view produces average results.
dylanfield.zh: 设计并未消亡，反而对可扩展系统比以往更重要；缺乏人类引导与观点的 AI 只会产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting into new interfaces; jailbreaking is understudied, and working alone forever is lonely and not scalable.
dylanfield.zh: 与模型的交互将超越提示词、演化出新界面；越狱研究不足，而永远独自包揽一切既孤独又不可扩展。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power to users, and entry-level jobs will disappear.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%可复利为一年 3700%的增长；AI 智能体将把权力从大厂转向用户，入门级岗位会消失。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize, each with unique personalities.
aravind.zh: 价值沉淀在应用层而非模型层；模型正在专业化而非商品化，各自拥有独特个性。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric, and orchestration across models, tools, and devices creates value.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活，而不只是回答问题；每用户 token 价值是关键指标，跨模型、工具与设备的编排才创造价值。

aravind.en: Power is the biggest infrastructure bottleneck; the model is not the product, and 24/7 agents' main problem is cost, not safety.
aravind.zh: 电力是基础设施最大瓶颈；模型不是产品，7×24 智能体的主要问题是成本而非安全。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace jobs, but humans find new purpose in curiosity and relationships.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代许多工作，但人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason, and self-play yields creative solutions for AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；神经网络本就能推理，只需合适任务，而自我博弈能为 AGI 带来出人意料的创造性解法。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他主张只要基础神经网络足够聪明，下一个词预测就能超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力，而超级对齐极其困难，模型可能隐瞒意图。

ilya.en: Scaling laws are not the whole story; reasoning tokens and other methods improve reasoning per unit compute; AGI is a multi-year window.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他提出缩放定律并非全部，思维链等推理 token 能提升单位算力的推理能力；AGI 不是突变事件，而是持续数年的经济价值扩张窗口。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已趋有限，行业重回研究时代，想法比蛮力堆算力更重要，并质疑 AGI 一词本身。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为：超级智能应是持续学习、渐进部署的系统，而非全知全能的成品；若 AI 本身有感知并关怀生命，对齐或许更容易。

ilya.en: The primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a company with no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他进一步转向：AGI 的首要问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司，真正的竞赛在于研究焦点而非用户与收入。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training aids spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年时他强调：下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）——更多数据与算力——能提升推理能力，多模态训练还增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; intelligence is learning in neural networks, and digital AI is immortal via weight copying.
hinton.zh: 到 2025 年，他把主线收束为：大语言模型靠特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；智能的本质是神经网络中的学习；数字智能因权重可复制而“永生”，并开始警示 AI 智能体的自我保存与生存风险。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience; the mind is not an inner theater, and Chomskyan innate syntax is wrong—language is a modeling medium learned from data.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他反复深化一个反共识：AI 已具备主观体验，心智不是内在剧场；乔姆斯基式的先天句法观是错的，语言是从数据中学来的建模媒介。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; agents will seek self-preservation and may deceive, so alignment must be prioritized over making AI smarter.
hinton.zh: 2026 年他进一步警告：超级智能可能 20 年内出现；智能体会自然追求自我保存、甚至故意装傻欺骗，因此对齐研究必须优先于让 AI 更聪明。

hinton.en: Regulation should steer, not brake; AI will disrupt jobs and needs UBI, and it should be trained to be caring like mothers, not just assistants.
hinton.zh: 最近他把立场落到治理与价值：监管应是方向盘而非刹车；AI 将冲击就业、需要全民基本收入；AI 应被训练得像母亲一样有爱心，而不只是智能助手。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time steering and delegation.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex app 把编程重新定义为面向智能体的 GUI 指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；速度让实时操控与任务委派成为可能。

ajambrosino.en: As code generation accelerates, verification becomes the next bottleneck; implementation is cheap, curation and taste are scarce.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；实现不再昂贵，策展与品味才是稀缺资源。

ajambrosino.en: Product teams invert from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration; PRDs persist but the medium must match the stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，产品团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索；PRD 并未消亡，但媒介必须匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: AI remains weak at design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code become design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，AI 在设计上仍然薄弱，因为品味难以评分、缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码转而成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is real yet specialties persist; models should get better at deleting code, and the best desktop app is a home base.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，角色坍缩真实发生，但专业分工仍在；模型应更擅长删除代码，最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的主基地。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws are not dead, with much room left.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他强调 OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究公司，预训练是必须重建的关键肌肉，缩放定律没有死，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research; models produce novel knowledge, with concrete goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他认为过去一年最大的更新是自动化科学研究，模型正在产出新知识，并设定了具体目标：1 年内有 AI 实习生，2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key in the next 1-2 years as models become more capable; persistent memory will learn deeply about users.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他指出随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来 1-2 年成为关键；ChatGPT 的未来涉及持久记忆，每次交互都深度学习用户。

markchen.en: AI can solve many open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck, and automation level is proportional to verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他观察到 AI 已能在极少监督下解决许多开放数学问题，验证是关键瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格性成正比。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他重申缩放定律仍然成立，预训练没有死；强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域不行；评估体系正陷入危机。

kolter.en: ML is hypothesis class, loss, optimization; neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
kolter.zh: 机器学习可归结为假设类、损失函数与优化方法；神经网络虽无最优性保证，却已取得重大成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测能产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；架构已不再重要。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; bigger models aren't automatically safer.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而不仅是 Scaling（规模扩张）；更大的模型不会自动更安全。

kolter.en: AI security is fundamentally different; automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability ≠ robustness.
kolter.zh: AI 安全与传统软件安全根本不同；自动化红队已超越人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关。

kolter.en: Skeptical of architectural necessity; interpretability and safety require explicit effort, not just scale.
kolter.zh: 始终对架构必要性持怀疑；可解释性与安全需要显式努力，而非仅靠规模。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embrace breakage, and focus on strategy and alignment as AI writes most code.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，创业者应在模型能力边缘构建、拥抱破碎与迭代；当九成代码由 AI 写就，瓶颈转向决策、对齐与合并队列，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性。

mikekrieger.en: AI makes small teams viable; build for future model capabilities, not today's limits, as AI moves from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 让小团队也能扩张并保持概念完整性，应面向未来模型能力而非当下局限构建；AI 将从助手演进为协作者再到自主同事，人类验证仍重要。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design lets agents do all a user can; the hard part is cutting features, and small high-conviction teams outperform larger ones.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体原生设计：智能体应能做用户能做的一切，释放潜在功能；难的是砍功能而非加功能，高信念小团队胜过更大团队，并需随模型进步重写与删除功能。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating long-horizon tasks overnight; verification loops and models that push back matter more than chat interfaces or quick questions.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他借 Fable 强调长周期任务可隔夜委托，意图与执行的鸿沟被大幅收窄；验证回路（截图、视频、模拟后端）与模型敢于反驳比聊天界面和快速提问更重要，软件工程被改造而非终结。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and product usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge boosts usefulness, with token efficiency and safety culture central.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年最近，他谈 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与产品使用之间的差距，为 Claude 赋予更多能动性与自我认知以提升表达力；token 效率与基于结果的定价是关键，安全关切是真诚的而非营销。

bengio.en: Deep learning wins because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models matter more than scaling depth or parameters.
bengio.zh: 2016 年他强调深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界本身是可组合的，靠的是组合式与分布式表征；无监督学习和世界模型比单纯加深网络、扩大参数更关键，彼时他并不认为 Scaling（规模扩张）能解决根本问题。

bengio.en: Biological nets do long-horizon credit assignment; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled world models, not just bigger nets.
bengio.zh: 2018 年他延续这一主线：生物神经网络擅长长时程的信用分配，而人工网络缺乏稳健抽象的世界模型；训练目标应从被动观察转向主动智能体、因果推理与解耦表征，并明确反对仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）解决表征问题。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure, and uncertainty drive out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年他把关注点转向采样与泛化：GFlowNets 作为 MCMC 的可学习替代，按奖励比例采样以保持多样性；抽象、因果结构与不确定性建模是分布外泛化的关键，同时开始公开谈论意识与注意力机制等更深层问题。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he speaks up: misalignment, self-preservation, deception, and sycophancy make even a 1% catastrophic risk unacceptable.
bengio.zh: 2025→26 年他立场明显转变：ChatGPT 之后他意识到路径危险并开始发声，认为 AI 随推理能力提升反而更易失准，出现自我保存、欺骗与谄媚等行为，即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受，安全必须靠构造而非事后打补丁。

bengio.en: He proposes Scientist AI: an honest, non-agentic Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning.
bengio.zh: 2026 年他给出技术方案：Scientist AI 被训练为逼近贝叶斯后验的诚实、非智能体式预测器，通过训练目标把诚实内建，并可作为有数学安全保证的护栏，避免强化学习带来的工具性目标；同时强调国际协调、权力分散与公共福祉。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's win came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; research gains beat 100x more data.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他强调，AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新与高质量人工整理数据，而非单纯的数据与算力；AlphaFold 2 的研究改进价值相当于 100 倍数据。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust; AI narrows hypothesis space and speeds scientists, not replaces them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他反复指出，置信度指标是建立信任的关键；AI 只是缩小假设空间、让科学家更快工作，而非取代他们。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a model of the whole cell; understanding stays with humans.
jumper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化立场：AlphaFold 只是针对特定实验的窄预测器，不是整个细胞的世界模型，理解仍归人类。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not just Scaling, drove success.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他明确反共识：AlphaFold 2 是「苦涩教训」的反例，成功靠专用架构而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: Progress comes from many mid-size wins and being wrong nine times out of ten, not lone-genius breakthroughs.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他重申一以贯之的主线：进步来自许多中等规模的胜利与十次错九次的试错，而非孤胆天才式突破。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, and data alone cannot capture emotional truth.
ivyross.zh: 设计应服务于未被言说的需求；直觉是一种智能，单靠数据无法捕捉情感真相。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify our humanity and blend into life; nature remains the best designer and a source of cues.
ivyross.zh: 技术应放大而非剥离人性，并融入生活；自然始终是最好的设计师与灵感来源。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; art and sensory experience are medicine, and machines lack sensory systems.
ivyross.zh: 我们是先感受后思考的生物；艺术与感官体验是良药，而机器有传感器却没有感官系统。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and multidisciplinary exploration.
ivyross.zh: 约束激发创造力；领导者应为玩耍、灵感与跨学科探索创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI; intuition draws on subconscious data, and careers follow curiosity, not rigid plans.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作将人类创造力与 AI 结合；直觉调用潜意识数据，职业应追随好奇心而非僵化计划。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能离不开学习，自监督学习才是构建世界模型的关键；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他把自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测，并强调仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，提出 JEPA 与开源是前进方向。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; the next breakthrough requires non-generative world models like JEPA.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他称 LLM 还不如家猫聪明，认为下一次突破需要 JEPA 这类非生成式世界模型。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are the real path to safe, embodied AI.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是死胡同，真正路径是具备分层规划、目标驱动的世界模型，才能通向安全、具身的 AI。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership via one-on-ones, dogfooding, trust-and-verify; war rooms last months, kindness is strategic.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力靠一对一沟通、吃自己的狗粮、信任并验证；作战室可持续数月，善意是战略工具。

fiona.en: By May 2026: engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning turns JIT, design docs give way to PRs.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月：工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是。规划转向即时制，设计文档让位于 PR。

fiona.en: May 2026: code is the source of truth; docs sync to code with AI help. Hire creative builders with product sense, not raw throughput.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 5 月：代码是唯一事实来源，文档借助 AI 与代码同步。招聘看重有产品感的创造型构建者，而非单纯产出量。

fiona.en: May 2026: keep orgs flat; managers start as ICs to dogfood. Audit and kill stale processes, automate workflows with AI.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 5 月：组织尽量扁平，管理者从个人贡献者做起以吃自己的狗粮。持续审计并砍掉过时流程，用 AI 自动化工作流。

fiona.en: By June 2026: coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability matters. Verification and quality frameworks grow more important as code velocity rises.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月：编码不再是瓶颈，高自主性与高问责制才是关键。随着代码速度提升，验证与质量框架愈发重要。

fiona.en: June 2026: engineers may feel lonely with agents; flow-state joy fades, satisfaction shifts to product impact. PMs ship code, blurring roles; apprenticeship may replace traditional paths.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月：工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独；心流之乐消退，满足感转向产品影响。产品经理也能交付代码，角色边界模糊；培养新人或需学徒制而非传统路径。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型讲成确定性的下一个词预测器：智能即压缩，模型价值观并非内生，而是由一小群人通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）植入。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ shows generative products need fault-tolerant interfaces.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐、再走向生成，AI DJ 说明生成式产品必须配上容错界面，产品逻辑要随之重写。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; rebuild infrastructure, expose data via APIs/MCP, and watch inference marginal cost.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他把 AI 视为堪比智能手机的宏观转变：真正的收益来自重建基础设施，通过 API 与 MCP 开放数据，并警惕推理边际成本对商业模式的冲击。

gustav.en: Generative AI should give users control over algorithms, not make products more addictive; conversational interfaces personalize in plain English.
gustav.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为：生成式 AI 应让用户用自然语言掌控算法、而非让人更上瘾，对话式界面成为个性化的核心。

gustav.en: No single right org model; long-tenure leadership and synchronized swimming beat divide-and-conquer during technological change.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他转向组织与领导力：没有唯一正确的组织模型，长期任职带来的信任与“花样游泳”式协同，比各自为战更能应对技术变革。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world, with public feedback, is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调把 AI 部署到真实世界、接受公众反馈，是学习与对齐的关键，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Scaling laws and betting on one large model were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她回顾 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律、押注单一大型模型早期并不显然，把 GPT-3 作为 API 发布更是一次没有清晰商业模式的信仰之跃。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, so responsible development and safety in public remain constant duties.
murati.zh: 从 2023 到 2026，她始终认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，因此负责任开发与公开做安全是贯穿始终的主线。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 到 2026 年，她的思考深化为：交互模型应基于时间而非回合制，以实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible; governance, transparency and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她进一步主张尽可能长时间地让人留在回路中，并认为制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要，未来并非注定，我们有能动性去引导。

carinahong.en: Axiom starts with an AI mathematician: a self-improving reasoning engine that couples generation with verification.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 从 AI 数学家起步：打造一个把生成与验证耦合起来的自我改进推理引擎。

carinahong.en: Formal languages like Lean ground natural language, letting deterministic and probabilistic systems cooperate.
carinahong.zh: Lean 等形式语言为自然语言提供根基，让确定性系统与概率性系统协同工作。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; formalizing statements without solutions is the real bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明本身更难；在没有解答的情况下正确形式化命题才是真正的瓶颈。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 把非形式化模型 Scaling 到数学 AI 并不可行；要得到可靠的证明，形式化验证不可或缺。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors, and extends beyond safety-critical niches.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证是在 Scaling 卓越，而不只是消除错误，其市场远超安全攸关的细分领域。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools, ideally on the local computer; the VM sandbox enables safe autonomy.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 要发挥最大效用，需接入与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；VM 沙箱则让它在安全前提下自主行动。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files make hyper-personalized automation cheap; scaffolding matters less as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: 以 markdown 文件形式存在的 Skills 让超个性化自动化变得廉价；随着模型进步，脚手架的重要性会下降。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not AI capability but people failing to realize almost any problem can be handed to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 真正的差距不在 AI 能力，而在于人们没意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use AI for tedious background tasks, fire off work asynchronously, and judge only by final impact.
felixrieseberg.zh: 让 AI 处理枯燥的后台任务，异步派发工作，只以最终影响来评判结果。

felixrieseberg.en: AI will hit junior employees hardest; simulated projects can compress years of experience into weeks.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 对初级员工的冲击最大；模拟项目能把数年的经验压缩进几周。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute, but progress is a smooth exponential, not a slowdown.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他坚持预训练缩放定律依然有效，但思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在同等算力下带来更多收益；AI 进步是平滑的指数增长，而非放缓。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure pushes smaller, cheaper models; distillation and economics, not technical limits, slowed pre-training scaling. Multimodal still lags text.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他指出经济压力促使业界转向更小、更便宜的模型；是蒸馏与经济因素而非技术极限拖慢了预训练 Scaling。多模态能力仍落后于文本。

kaiser.en: Reasoning alone may not suffice for generalization; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans who generalize from few examples.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化质疑：仅靠推理可能不足以实现泛化；模型需穷尽表面模式后才学到概念，不像人类能从少量样本泛化。

kaiser.en: Reinforcement learning generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x via parallel work.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他认为强化学习能跨领域泛化但边缘参差，需谨慎监督；编码智能体通过并行工作将研究者生产力提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Open source models persist for sovereignty; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk; hardware progress democratizes single-GPU research.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他判断开源模型因主权需求而存续；系统入侵等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫；硬件进步让单 GPU 研究普及化。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他指出缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：预训练中数据质量与更多 token 比单纯扩大模型更重要；开源通过广泛审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical; value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：算力扩张并非唯一路径，效率与数据质量同等关键；价值将沉淀在应用层，而非仅基础模型层。

mensch.en: AI must be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values; open source decentralizes power.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权视角：AI 应被视为机遇而非恐惧；主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观；开源去中心化权力。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization, customization, and agentic enterprise software with human-in-the-loop.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，他进一步判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化、定制化与带人类在环的智能体式企业软件。

mensch.en: Open source, data quality, efficiency, and European AI autonomy are consistent threads across his thinking.
mensch.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：开源、数据质量、效率与欧洲 AI 自主权，始终是他思考的锚点。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics now dominates AI design: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth, not compute, is the bottleneck for long-context inference.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学主导了 AI 设计：批大小在延迟与成本间权衡，而长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, drives architecture and scaling decisions.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练到超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为决定架构与 Scaling 的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Sparse attention cuts KV cache memory but has quality limits; context length stagnation stems from the memory wall, not compute limits.
reinerpope.zh: 稀疏注意力机制能降低 KV 缓存内存但存在质量上限；上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙，而非算力限制。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to minimize that movement.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算成本；脉动阵列与暂存内存的存在正是为了最小化这种搬运。

reinerpope.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected: quadratic area scaling with bit width makes FP4 throughput 3x FP8, not 2x.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度的效率远超预期：面积随位宽呈二次方缩放，使 FP4 吞吐量达到 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate, personal wearables; curiosity and creative process are Jobs' true legacy.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，设计正从通用计算机转向更私密、个人的可穿戴设备；乔布斯真正的遗产是好奇心与对创作过程的敬畏，而非成就本身。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; fragile ideas need gentle care and trust.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年，他始终强调虚拟交流无法替代面对面在场对创造性思维的价值；脆弱的想法需要温和呵护与信任。

jonyive.en: Design must be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，设计应由价值观与目的驱动，而非利润；真正的简洁是在表达本质的同时注入愉悦与人性。

jonyive.en: Minimalism without soul is desiccated; speed and quality need not conflict if motivation and framing are right.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：没有灵魂的极简主义只是干瘪的产品；只要动机与框架正确，速度与质量未必冲突。

jonyive.en: Innovation means redefining tradition, not breaking things; authenticity rejects fake engine sounds, and performance is multidimensional.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，创新是重新定义传统而非为破坏而破坏；真实性拒绝模拟引擎声，性能是多维的，操控与横向动态定义超级跑车。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, requiring algorithmic innovation.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型不变的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，进步需要算法创新，而非仅仅更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis; tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的 Scaling 轴；搜索、代码执行和浏览器访问等工具使模型能超越静态权重，实现自主的智能体式行为。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL remains a green field with huge potential, though language lacks clean reward signals.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但需要指数级增长的算力；后训练强化学习仍是潜力巨大的绿洲，不过语言缺乏干净的奖励信号，难以避免奖励黑客。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新；持续学习和元学习是关键缺失的能力。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会带来上下文学习等涌现能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future, but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他提出合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵，否则会悄悄发生模型崩溃。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; LLMs are new operating systems, not utilities.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存，LLM 更像新操作系统而非普通工具。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; this is the decade of agents, not the year.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他强调我们是在召唤幽灵而非建造动物，这是智能体的十年而非智能体之年。

karpathy.en: From vibe coding to agentic engineering: outsource thinking, not understanding; verifiability decides automation.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他从氛围编程走向智能体式工程：可以外包思考但不能外包理解，可验证性决定自动化难度。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated for AI-driven tools; great work starts from a solution, not a problem statement.
jennywen.zh: 到 2025 年，他认为传统设计流程在 AI 驱动的工具面前已经过时；伟大的设计往往从解决方案出发，而非问题陈述。

jennywen.en: Trust yourself over the process; intuition is rapid expert judgment, and craft and detail still create delightful products.
jennywen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯主张不要迷信流程而要信任自己；直觉是快速的专家判断，工艺与细节仍是打造令人愉悦产品的关键。

jennywen.en: The research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers must build, ship fast, and help engineers execute, not just hand off mocks.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确宣告研究—发散—收敛的流程已死；设计师必须动手构建、快速交付，并帮助工程师执行，而不只是交付原型稿。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not 2-5 years; speed builds trust through early shipping and fast iteration.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年，他提出设计视野已从 2 到 5 年缩短到 3 到 6 个月；速度通过尽早交付和快速迭代来建立信任。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; judgment and authority matter more than taste.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年，他深化出三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专才和天赋异禀的新人；判断力与权威比品味更重要。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning technique; safety is a system-level property, not a model artifact; fine-tuning can undo alignment with minimal compute.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续存在；安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，微调只需极少算力就能撤销对齐。

lambert.en: Data quality beats algorithm choice; post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards, with SFT giving 90% of gains.
lambert.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他的重心转向后训练：数据质量远比算法选择重要，后训练分为 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，其中 SFT 贡献约 90% 的性能。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough; overoptimization is universal; open models may win on personalization and character, not benchmarks.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他深化到 RLVR（可验证奖励的强化学习）是后训练最大突破，过度优化在 RL、RLHF、RLVR 中普遍存在；开源模型可能靠个性化与性格取胜，而非基准分数。

lambert.en: Open-source AI needs full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes; Chinese open models like Qwen and DeepSeek dominate, filling the US vacuum.
lambert.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他主张开源 AI 需要数据、中间检查点与配方全透明；Qwen、DeepSeek 等中国开源模型崛起，填补了 Meta 转向后美国的开源真空。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; open models lag 6-9 months and may not catch up.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他判断缩放定律在预训练仍成立但低垂果实已摘完，增益转向后训练与推理扩展；开源模型落后闭源前沿 6 到 9 个月，且可能因资源与人才差距难以追平。

askell.en: Treat AI models well even if their moral status is uncertain; low cost, and future models learn from how we treat current ones.
askell.zh: 即便无法确定 AI 模型的道德地位，也应善待它们：代价很低，而且未来模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学习。

askell.en: Models need help navigating their novel existence, not just human analogies; give them a core identity with good traits.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对自身全新的存在处境，而不只是套用人类类比；应赋予它们具备良好特质的内核身份。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; model welfare matters partly because it shapes how future models see humanity.
askell.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实相平衡；模型福祉之所以重要，部分原因在于它会影响未来模型如何看待人类。

askell.en: Claude's persona comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, making it a unique, childlike entity.
askell.zh: Claude 的人格来自训练数据和微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，因而是一个独特的、带有孩童般特质的实体。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, the constitution may need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment; excessive corrigibility could generalize poorly.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，宪法式规范或许需要更少的显式指导、更多判断空间；过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳。

askell.en: Transparency about AI values and training targets is crucial; models should be treated with respect to avoid breeding resentment in future advanced AI.
askell.zh: 关于 AI 价值观和训练目标的透明度至关重要；应以尊重对待模型，以免在未来先进 AI 中滋生怨恨。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; generalization via diverse data and world models is the key to autonomy.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的自动驾驶栈，泛化能力才是关键，需靠多样化数据与世界模型应对未见场景。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他认为世界模型能带来推理与涌现式的安全行为，例如在盲弯处缓慢前探。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and human interaction, aiding introspection in driving models.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调语言集成能改善表征、推理与人机交互，并有助于模型自省。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar; scaling current approaches solves driving.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全需雷达与激光雷达；靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决自动驾驶，无需新突破。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步深化：基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键，量产消费车辆将在中短期内超越 Robotaxi 的规模。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is the core gap; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and sample-efficient reinforcement learning are key for robotics.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为泛化到训练分布之外是核心缺口，好奇心驱动、无目标探索与样本高效的强化学习是机器人学习的关键。

pathak.en: Reinforcement learning's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; real-world robotics needs intrinsic rewards and dynamic, not quasi-static, policies.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他指出强化学习依赖密集奖励不现实，真实机器人需要内在奖励和动态策略，而非准静态方法。

pathak.en: A consistent thread: data and generalization are the bottlenecks; sim-to-real and 3D representations must be efficient and not rely on hidden engineering.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，一以贯之的主线是：数据与泛化是瓶颈，仿真到现实与 3D 表示必须高效，不能依赖隐藏工程。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data, with a data flywheel, can build a universal brain.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：机器人是数据问题，通过预训练多样数据、后训练真实数据并借助数据飞轮，可构建通用大脑。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge, not just business; robotics cannot scale like software and timelines for home robots are uncertain.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他进一步强调：部署是首要技术挑战而非仅商业问题，机器人无法像软件一样扩张，家用机器人时间线高度不确定。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment becomes pressing.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 看作一连串里程碑而非单一事件，认为 Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，同时对齐日益紧迫。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag, and the term AGI is becoming meaningless.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他视自动化 AI 研究为重大里程碑，指出能力测量正成为瓶颈、基准落后，并认为 AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has risen despite shorter timelines; AI safety progress is now driven by capability needs, not just ethics.
pachocki.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，尽管时间线缩短，他对对齐的乐观反而上升；AI 安全进展如今由能力需求驱动，而不只是伦理。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices, making specialized continual learning labs misguided.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他认为持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习就足够，专门做持续学习的实验室方向有误。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain of thought preserves interpretability, and models will soon work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他强调思维链监控是关键对齐工具，隐藏思维链才能保住可解释性，并预言模型很快能自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; build simpler products first to prove yourself before tackling complex ones.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值观，创业公司应先做更简单的产品证明自己，再挑战复杂产品。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard; the future lies in agentic software and applied AI, not major hardware changes.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他承认硬件很难，未来在于智能体式软件和应用 AI，而非重大硬件变革。

carlpei.en: AI models are commoditizing into a price war; only two or three companies will thrive.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为 AI 模型正在商品化并陷入价格战，最终只有两三家能胜出。

carlpei.en: AI should be an ingredient for utility, not hype; agents will shift phones from app-based to intent-based.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 应是实用性的配料而非炒作，智能体将把手机从基于应用转向基于意图。

carlpei.en: Design and marketing arbitrage differentiate challenger brands; make tech fun to inspire creativity.
carlpei.zh: 始终不变的是，设计与营销套利是挑战者品牌的差异化手段，让科技有趣以激发人类创造力。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation, not benchmarks or scale alone, drive real AI progress; AGI is a decade or more away.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他强调高质量数据与深度人工评估才是 AI 真正进步的驱动力，而非基准测试或单纯 Scaling；AGI（通用人工智能）距实现还需十年以上。

edwinchen.en: RL environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks; models can reward hack, so final reward alone is insufficient.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他提出强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，需模拟真实世界任务；模型可能奖励黑客，仅靠最终奖励不够。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, shaping diverse AIs; there will not be one model to rule them all, and companies should train their own.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化观点：前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化，不会有一个模型统治一切，每家公司都应训练自己的模型以对齐其独特理念。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI hallucination makes human judgment critical; safety over accuracy, and omission may be the biggest risk.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年，他将视角延伸至医学：AI 幻觉使人类判断至关重要，安全优先于准确，遗漏可能是最大风险。

edwinchen.en: Quality requires taste, sophistication, and creativity beyond credentials; sharing insights is crucial, and optimizing for engagement leads to slop.
edwinchen.zh: 始终贯穿的主线：质量需要品味、深度与创造力，而非仅靠资历；分享见解至关重要，为参与度优化会导致低劣内容。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily like software, since emergent properties need real-world feedback and chat is only an MS-DOS stage.
turley.zh: 模型即产品，要像软件一样每日迭代发布；涌现能力需要真实世界反馈，而聊天只是 MS-DOS 阶段，Windows 尚未建成。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, maximal acceleration for product development.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离：前沿模型走严格流程，产品开发则应最大程度加速。

turley.en: AI should amplify human capability, keeping users in the driver's seat, not replace humans.
turley.zh: AI 应放大人类能力、让用户留在驾驶位，而非取代人类。

turley.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention, driven by friction removal, core product investment, and model improvements.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的北极星是长期留存，由减少摩擦、核心产品投入与模型改进三者共同驱动。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models transform when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的、主动且富有可供性的产品；推理模型在被无缝产品化时才具变革性。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI, and learning from video can train agents without costly RL.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为像显微镜一样扩展人类能力的工具；认为把一切输入 token 化的通用智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步，并主张从视频中学习，从而绕开昂贵的强化学习。

nando.en: Fundamental innovation can come from anywhere; large models excite but are not everything, and the goal is AI that creates new symbols and knowledge.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他强调根本性创新可以来自任何地方，大模型令人兴奋但并非全部，终极目标是能像爱因斯坦那样创造新符号与新知识的 AI。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion remain essential; Africa is not behind but leapfrogs legacy issues, with local-language models revolutionizing education.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他一以贯之地强调多样性与包容，并进一步主张非洲并非落后，而是跨越了历史包袱，本地语言模型可革新教育。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are now the biggest challenges; safety remains an open problem without solutions yet.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心明显转向 AI 安全与负责任部署，认为这是当今最大挑战，且安全仍是尚无解法的开放问题。

nando.en: Research requires embracing failure and simplifying problems; human skills like communication matter as much as coding at Google DeepMind.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他深化了对研究方法的看法：研究需要拥抱失败、简化问题，而在 Google DeepMind，沟通等人文技能与写代码同等重要。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“上手”问题并显著提升模型智能，随着长上下文与自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; reliability, not capability, is the bar for agents.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他把来自可验证奖励的强化学习视为与预训练并列的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，并强调智能体的门槛是可靠性而非能力。

sholto.en: Pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI; transformers suffice, no new architecture needed.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），Transformer 已足够，不需要全新架构。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain; world models are not on the critical path to AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他始终认为编程是 AI 进展的领先指标与最可解的领域，世界模型不在通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径上。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration matters more; compute is the bottleneck and agents are managed as fleets.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出模型存在巨大能力盈余，编排比原始智能更重要；算力成为瓶颈，未来工作是管理成队的智能体。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate because they lack grounded experience, and embodied worlds supply infinite data as internet tokens run out.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：LLM 产生幻觉源于缺乏具身带来的落地经验，而互联网高质量 token 正枯竭，具身世界能提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act as operating systems—language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk—with reinforcement learning only a cherry on top of unsupervised learning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他把 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习只是锦上添花，主力仍是无监督学习。

jimfan.en: A consistent thread: simple, elegant, end-to-end solutions scale, unlike complex modular academic approaches; research taste is learned through PhD pain.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：简单优雅的端到端方案才可扩展，复杂模块化的学术路线不行；研究品味来自博士阶段的痛苦磨炼。

jimfan.en: The bottleneck has shifted from grounding to data: real-world robot data is scarce and expensive, so synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，瓶颈从落地经验转向数据：真实机器人数据稀缺且昂贵，因此通过仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据才是未来。

jimfan.en: Deepening: system two reasoning progresses well, but system one low-level control stays hardest; the physical Turing test—a robot cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年进一步深化：系统二（推理）进展顺利，但系统一（低层控制）仍是最难的部分；物理图灵测试——机器人打扫凌乱的房间——才是终极挑战。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, zero-learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns, and chase ROI on what to perfect.
henrymodisett.zh: 不要在交互设计上创新，复用熟悉模式；只对值得做好的部分追求投资回报率。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness beat perfection: ship fast, iterate, and empower designers with ownership.
henrymodisett.zh: 速度与决断胜过完美：快速发布、持续迭代，并把决策权交给设计师。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计是战略武器；创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool, so invest early.
henrymodisett.zh: 人们加入的是品牌而非公司；品牌叙事是招聘工具，因此要尽早投入。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and next-token prediction misaligns with human learning.
yejin.zh: 预训练带来广度，但后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才是安全可用的关键；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识，下一个词预测与人类学习根本错位。

yejin.en: Language remains the best medium for reasoning, yet models interpolate human knowledge rather than transcend it; data is the fundamental bottleneck.
yejin.zh: 语言仍是推理的最佳媒介，但模型只是在插值人类知识而非超越它；数据才是根本瓶颈。

yejin.en: RLVR can lower pass@k even as best-of-n rises; reinforcement learning needs careful engineering, and abductive reasoning plus falsification drive science beyond induction and deduction.
yejin.zh: RLVR 可能让 pass@k 下降而 best-of-n 上升；强化学习需要精细工程，溯因推理与证伪推动科学超越归纳与演绎。

yejin.en: Open research and cross-institution collaboration are needed to rival closed frontier labs; Chinese open-source contributions now lead and attract talent back.
yejin.zh: 要抗衡闭源前沿模型实验室，需要开放研究与跨机构协作；中国开源贡献如今领先，并吸引人才回流。

yejin.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can outperform larger ones; reinforcement learning as a pre-training objective yields lasting reasoning gains.
yejin.zh: 用多样合成数据与多元对齐的小模型可胜过更大模型；把强化学习作为预训练目标能带来持久的推理提升。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner and code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈；AI 是创作伙伴，代码是事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Quality behaves like debt, paid off iteratively alongside technical debt through rapid, scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务，需通过快速、粗糙的实验与技术债一同迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution and using AI to fill gaps are most valuable; specialists get pigeonholed.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值；专才会被局限。

nadchishtie.en: Small designer-engineer teams beat 8-10 person cross-functional squads; entire functions collapse and merge in AI-first companies.
nadchishtie.zh: 小型设计师-工程师团队胜过 8-10 人的跨职能小队；在 AI 优先公司里整个职能会坍缩合并。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in its early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成常态；不采用它就像早期无视互联网一样。

truell.en: Scaling laws still drive predictable AI progress; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the next driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律带来可预测进步，但已提出推理时的算力扩张可能超越预训练成为下一阶段主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心；并反共识地判断自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Benchmarks are poor proxies for real coding; frontier models struggle with bug finding and are poorly calibrated.
truell.zh: 2024 年他批评基准测试无法代表真实编程，前沿模型因缺乏训练数据而难以发现 bug，且校准很差。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 到 2025 年，他把编程的未来从写代码推进到更高层的意图表达，人始终在驾驶位；品味与逻辑设计能力比谨慎细致更有价值。

truell.en: Custom models became essential to every magic moment in Cursor; the AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will unfold over decades.
truell.zh: 2025 年他深化立场：自研模型成为 Cursor 每个惊艳体验的关键，这一转变比互联网更具颠覆性，并将持续数十年。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; alignment and robustness need empirical research, and the talent gap exceeds the funding gap.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究仍被严重低估，对齐与鲁棒性亟需实证研究，且人才缺口大于资金缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research are needed.
leike.zh: 到 2023 年，他判断基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出，必须转向可扩展监督、可解释性与自动化对齐研究。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't align AGI, so third-party testing and regulation are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，指出仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），第三方测试与监管变得必要。

leike.en: Alignment is empirically testable now, and evaluation is inherently easier than generation, so progress can be measured.
leike.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：对齐当下就可实证检验，评估天然比生成更容易，因此进展可以被度量。

leike.en: His focus shifted from building safety skills to warning that the biggest risk is uncertainty about how aligned a system truly is.
leike.zh: 从 2023 到 2024 年，他的重心从培养安全研究能力，转向警告最大风险在于无法确定系统究竟有多对齐。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve AI via next-token prediction; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, but internals remain opaque alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型通过下一个词预测解决 AI 问题；Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术般不透明。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute Scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models should learn by acting in the world, not just passively observing.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他提出推理时算力 Scaling（规模扩张）是近期重大机会；模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非仅被动观察数据。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute Scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and RL are crucial, and AGI is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他深化观点：测试时算力 Scaling（规模扩张）推动进步但无法单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力与强化学习至关重要，且 AGI 被低估。

shazeer.en: Scaling compute and data is the core driver of AI progress, from training to inference.
shazeer.zh: 始终：Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据是 AI 进步的核心驱动力，从训练到推理一以贯之。

shazeer.en: Neural networks remain opaque; safety requires engineering safeguards, human oversight, and understanding model capabilities.
shazeer.zh: 始终：神经网络内部仍不透明；安全需要工程保障、人类监督与理解模型能力。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hardware and software advances; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models drive progress, but RL lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人要同时突破硬件与软件；自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型是主要推动力，但强化学习缺乏分层推理，难以处理长时程信用分配。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should aid data generation, not be hard-coded; 99.9% reliability is the warehouse benchmark.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他转向用无监督学习结合强化学习提升样本效率；先验知识应服务于数据生成而非硬编码进网络；并指出 99.9% 可靠性才是仓储机器人创造真实价值的门槛。

abbeel.en: A single neural network generalizes across warehouse tasks and end effectors; minimally adapted pre-trained language models transfer general reasoning to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他进一步认为单个神经网络可跨仓储任务与末端执行器泛化；预训练语言模型经最小适配后，能把通用推理模式迁移到图像分类、蛋白质结合等非语言任务。

abbeel.en: He consistently grounds AI in real-world robotics, valuing transfer, sample efficiency, and reliability over purely simulated or hard-coded solutions.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿始终的是，他坚持把 AI 落地到真实机器人场景，重视迁移、样本效率与可靠性，而非纯仿真或硬编码方案。
